This file is a merged representation of the entire codebase, combined into a single document by Repomix.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

================
File: src/components/AIAssistant.tsx
================
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Bot, Send, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { sfx, useLibrary, useTree } from '../shared'

/* ============ الإعدادات (غيّرها هنا مباشرة) ============ */
// اختياري: رابط خادمك الذي يحتفظ بمفتاح الذكاء الاصطناعي.
// يستقبل { question, context } ويعيد { answer }. لا تضع مفتاح النموذج داخل كود المتصفح أبداً.
const AI_ENDPOINT = ''

export default function AIAssistant() {
  const { items } = useLibrary()
  const { accent: color, titleOf } = useTree()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [log, setLog] = useState<{ role: 'me' | 'ai'; text: string }[]>([])

  const ask = async () => {
    const question = q.trim()
    if (!question) return
    setQ('')
    sfx.click()
    setLog(l => [...l, { role: 'me', text: question }])

    // البحث المحلي في أسماء الملفات وأنواعها وأسماء الفروع (يعمل دون أي إعداد)
    const words = question.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 1)
    const hits = items.filter(i =>
      words.some(w => `${i.name} ${i.kind} ${titleOf(i.nodeId)}`.toLowerCase().includes(w)),
    )
    let answer = hits.length
      ? `وجدت ${hits.length}: ${hits.map(h => `${h.name} (${titleOf(h.nodeId)})`).join('، ')}.`
      : `لا توجد نتائج. مكتبتك تحتوي ${items.length} ملف.`

    if (AI_ENDPOINT) {
      try {
        const context = items.map(i => `${i.name} (${i.kind}, ${titleOf(i.nodeId)})`)
        const r = await fetch(AI_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ question, context }),
        })
        answer = (await r.json()).answer
      } catch {
        answer += ' (تعذّر الوصول لخدمة الذكاء الاصطناعي، هذه نتائج البحث المحلي.)'
      }
    }
    setLog(l => [...l, { role: 'ai', text: answer }])
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-20" dir="rtl">
      {open ? (
        <div className="flex h-96 w-80 max-w-[90vw] flex-col rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#14171f]/95 shadow-xl">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 p-3">
            <b>مساعد المكتبة</b>
            <button aria-label="إغلاق المساعد" onClick={() => { setOpen(false); sfx.close() }}><X size={16} /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto p-3 text-sm">
            {!log.length && <p className="opacity-60">اسأل عن أي ملف رفعته، مثل «ابحث عن ملفات الصوت».</p>}
            {log.map((m, i) => (
              <p key={i} className={m.role === 'me' ? 'opacity-80' : ''} style={m.role === 'ai' ? { color } : {}}>{m.text}</p>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2 border-t border-white/10 p-2">
            <input
              value={q}
              onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && ask()}
              placeholder="ابحث في مكتبتك"
              className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded bg-white/10 px-2 py-1 text-sm outline-none"
            />
            <button aria-label="إرسال" onClick={ask}><Send size={16} className="-scale-x-100" /></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          aria-label="فتح المساعد"
          onClick={() => { setOpen(true); sfx.open() }}
          className="rounded-full p-3 text-black"
          style={{ background: color }}
        >
          <Bot />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

================
File: src/components/AIChat.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Send } from 'lucide-react'
import { useLibrary, useTree } from '../shared'
import { ACCENT, askAI, hasAI, panel } from './toolkit'

interface Msg {
  role: 'me' | 'ai'
  text: string
}

// محادثة عن مكتبتك: بحث محلي في الملفات، ومع AI_ENDPOINT (في toolkit.ts) تصبح محادثة ذكاء اصطناعي كاملة
export default function AIChat() {
  const { items } = useLibrary()
  const { titleOf } = useTree()
  const [msgs, setMsgs] = useState<Msg[]>([])
  const [q, setQ] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const end = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => { end.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'end' }) }, [msgs])

  const send = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const question = q.trim()
    if (!question || busy) return
    setQ('')
    setMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'me', text: question }])
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      let answer: string
      if (hasAI()) {
        const ctx = items.map(i => `${i.name} (${i.kind}, ${titleOf(i.nodeId)})`).join('\n')
        answer = await askAI('chat', `ملفات المستخدم:\n${ctx || '(لا توجد ملفات)'}\n\nسؤال المستخدم: ${question}`)
      } else {
        const words = question.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 1)
        const hits = items.filter(i => words.some(w => `${i.name} ${i.kind} ${titleOf(i.nodeId)}`.toLowerCase().includes(w)))
        answer = hits.length
          ? `وجدت ${hits.length}: ${hits.map(h => `${h.name} (${titleOf(h.nodeId)})`).join('، ')}.`
          : `لا توجد نتائج. مكتبتك تحتوي ${items.length} ملف. (للمحادثة الذكية ضع AI_ENDPOINT في toolkit.ts)`
      }
      setMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'ai', text: answer }])
    } catch (e) {
      setMsgs(m => [...m, { role: 'ai', text: (e as Error).message }])
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full min-h-60 flex-col gap-2">
      <div className="flex-1 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto text-sm">
        {!msgs.length && <p className="opacity-60">اسأل عن أي ملف في مكتبتك، مثل «ابحث عن ملفات الصوت».</p>}
        {msgs.map((m, i) => (
          <p key={i} className={m.role === 'me' ? `${panel} p-2 opacity-90` : 'whitespace-pre-wrap p-1'} style={m.role === 'ai' ? { color: ACCENT } : undefined}>
            {m.text}
          </p>
        ))}
        {busy && <p className="text-xs opacity-60">جارٍ الكتابة…</p>}
        <div ref={end} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <input
          value={q}
          onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && void send()}
          placeholder="اكتب سؤالك"
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#a78bfa]"
        />
        <button aria-label="إرسال" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void send()} className="rounded-lg px-3 text-black transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-60" style={{ background: ACCENT }}>
          <Send size={15} className="-scale-x-100" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

================
File: src/components/AIMathSolver.tsx
================
import { useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { compile, derivative, evaluate, format, parse, simplify } from 'mathjs'
import { ACCENT, askAI, btn, field, hasAI, panel } from './toolkit'

interface Step { t: string; mono?: boolean }
const fm = (x: number) => String(+x.toFixed(6))

/* ============ المنطق: محلّل تعبيرات + جدول الحقيقة ============ */
type F = (e: Record<string, boolean>) => boolean
const OPS: Record<string, string> = { and: 'AND', '&&': 'AND', '∧': 'AND', or: 'OR', '||': 'OR', '∨': 'OR', not: 'NOT', '!': 'NOT', '~': 'NOT', '¬': 'NOT', xor: 'XOR', '->': 'IMP', '=>': 'IMP', '→': 'IMP', '<->': 'IFF', '↔': 'IFF', true: 'TRUE', false: 'FALSE', '1': 'TRUE', '0': 'FALSE' }

function parseLogic(s: string) {
  const re = /\s*(<->|↔|->|=>|→|∧|∨|¬|&&|\|\||\(|\)|!|~|[A-Za-z_]\w*|[01])/y
  const toks: string[] = []
  while (re.lastIndex < s.length) {
    const m = re.exec(s)
    if (!m) { if (s.slice(re.lastIndex).trim() === '') break; throw new Error('رمز غير مفهوم') }
    toks.push(OPS[m[1].toLowerCase()] ?? m[1])
  }
  const vars = new Set<string>()
  let i = 0
  const prim = (): F => {
    const t = toks[i++]
    if (t === undefined) throw new Error('التعبير ناقص')
    if (t === 'NOT') { const f = prim(); return e => !f(e) }
    if (t === '(') { const f = iff(); if (toks[i++] !== ')') throw new Error('قوس غير مغلق'); return f }
    if (t === 'TRUE') return () => true
    if (t === 'FALSE') return () => false
    if (/^[A-Za-z_]\w*$/.test(t) && !['AND', 'OR', 'XOR', 'IMP', 'IFF'].includes(t)) { vars.add(t); return e => e[t] }
    throw new Error('رمز غير متوقع: ' + t)
  }
  const bin = (next: () => F, op: string, join: (a: boolean, b: boolean) => boolean): F => {
    let f = next()
    while (toks[i] === op) { i++; const a = f, g = next(); f = e => join(a(e), g(e)) }
    return f
  }
  const and = () => bin(prim, 'AND', (a, b) => a && b)
  const xor = () => bin(and, 'XOR', (a, b) => a !== b)
  const or = () => bin(xor, 'OR', (a, b) => a || b)
  const imp = (): F => { const f = or(); if (toks[i] === 'IMP') { i++; const g = imp(); return e => !f(e) || g(e) } return f }
  const iff = () => bin(imp, 'IFF', (a, b) => a === b)
  const f = iff()
  if (i < toks.length) throw new Error('تعبير غير مكتمل أو فيه رمز زائد')
  return { f, vars: [...vars].sort() }
}

function solveLogic(s: string): Step[] {
  const { f, vars } = parseLogic(s)
  if (vars.length > 6) return [{ t: 'عدد المتغيرات أكبر من 6، الجدول سيكون كبيراً جداً.' }]
  const rows: boolean[] = []
  const lines = [[...vars, 'النتيجة'].join('  ')]
  for (let m = 0; m < 2 ** vars.length; m++) {
    const env: Record<string, boolean> = {}
    vars.forEach((v, j) => { env[v] = !!((m >> (vars.length - 1 - j)) & 1) })
    const r = f(env)
    rows.push(r)
    lines.push([...vars.map(v => (env[v] ? '1' : '0').padEnd(v.length)), r ? '1' : '0'].join('  '))
  }
  const kind = rows.every(Boolean) ? 'تحصيل حاصل (Tautology): صحيح دائماً' : rows.every(r => !r) ? 'تناقض (Contradiction): خاطئ دائماً' : 'قابل للتحقق (Contingency): يصح في بعض الحالات ويخطئ في غيرها'
  return [
    { t: `المتغيرات: ${vars.join('، ') || 'لا يوجد'}. عدد الحالات الممكنة 2^${vars.length} = ${rows.length}.` },
    { t: 'نحسب قيمة التعبير في كل حالة (1 = صحيح، 0 = خاطئ):' },
    { t: lines.join('\n'), mono: true },
    { t: `الخلاصة: ${kind}.` },
  ]
}

/* ============ المعادلات والمشتقات والتعابير ============ */
function freeVars(expr: string): string[] {
  const names = new Set<string>()
  parse(expr).traverse((n: any, path: string, parent: any) => {
    if (n.type === 'SymbolNode' && !(parent?.type === 'FunctionNode' && path === 'fn')) names.add(n.name)
  })
  ;['pi', 'e', 'i', 'Infinity', 'NaN', 'true', 'false'].forEach(k => names.delete(k))
  return [...names]
}

const term = (c: number, s: string) => (c === 0 ? '' : ` ${c < 0 ? '-' : '+'} ${Math.abs(c) === 1 && s ? '' : fm(Math.abs(c))}${s}`)

function solveEquation(eq: string): Step[] {
  const parts = eq.split('=')
  if (parts.length !== 2) return [{ t: 'اكتب معادلة واحدة فيها علامة = واحدة.' }]
  const [l, r] = parts
  const vars = freeVars(`(${l}) + (${r})`)
  if (vars.length !== 1) return [{ t: `المعادلة فيها ${vars.length} متغيرات. المحلّل المحلي يحلّ معادلات بمتغير واحد، استخدم زر الذكاء الاصطناعي للحالات الأعقد.` }]
  const v = vars[0]
  const g = compile(`(${l}) - (${r})`)
  const f = (x: number) => Number(g.evaluate({ [v]: x }))
  const c = f(0), p = f(1), m = f(-1)
  const a = (p + m - 2 * c) / 2, b = (p - m) / 2
  const isPoly = [2, 3, -2].every(x => Math.abs(f(x) - (a * x * x + b * x + c)) < 1e-6 * (1 + Math.abs(f(x))))
  const steps: Step[] = [{ t: `المتغير المجهول: ${v}. ننقل كل الحدود إلى طرف واحد فتصبح المعادلة f(${v}) = 0.` }]

  if (isPoly) {
    const poly = (term(a, `${v}²`) + term(b, v) + term(c, '')).trim().replace(/^\+ /, '') || '0'
    steps.push({ t: `بعد الترتيب: ${poly} = 0` })
    if (Math.abs(a) < 1e-12) {
      if (Math.abs(b) < 1e-12) return [...steps, { t: Math.abs(c) < 1e-12 ? 'المعادلة صحيحة لكل قيم المتغير (عدد لا نهائي من الحلول).' : 'لا يوجد حل، لأن المعادلة تؤول إلى تناقض.' }]
      return [...steps, { t: `معادلة من الدرجة الأولى: ${fm(b)}${v} = ${fm(-c)}` }, { t: `نقسم على ${fm(b)}: ${v} = ${fm(-c / b)}` }, { t: `الحل: ${v} = ${fm(-c / b)}` }]
    }
    const d = b * b - 4 * a * c
    steps.push({ t: `معادلة تربيعية: a = ${fm(a)}، b = ${fm(b)}، c = ${fm(c)}.` }, { t: `المميّز Δ = b² − 4ac = ${fm(d)}` })
    if (d > 0) {
      const s = Math.sqrt(d)
      steps.push({ t: `Δ > 0 فيوجد حلّان حقيقيان مختلفان: ${v} = (−b ± √Δ) / 2a` }, { t: `${v}₁ = ${fm((-b + s) / (2 * a))}\n${v}₂ = ${fm((-b - s) / (2 * a))}`, mono: true })
    } else if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-12) {
      steps.push({ t: `Δ = 0 فيوجد حل واحد مكرر: ${v} = −b / 2a = ${fm(-b / (2 * a))}` })
    } else {
      steps.push({ t: `Δ < 0 فلا يوجد حل حقيقي، والحلّان مركّبان:` }, { t: `${v} = ${fm(-b / (2 * a))} ± ${fm(Math.sqrt(-d) / (2 * a))}i`, mono: true })
    }
    return steps
  }

  // حل عددي: مسح المجال ثم التنصيف
  const roots: number[] = []
  for (let x = -100; x < 100 && roots.length < 8; x += 0.05) {
    const y0 = f(x), y1 = f(x + 0.05)
    if (isFinite(y0) && isFinite(y1) && y0 * y1 <= 0 && y0 !== y1) {
      let lo = x, hi = x + 0.05
      for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) { const mid = (lo + hi) / 2; f(lo) * f(mid) <= 0 ? (hi = mid) : (lo = mid) }
      const rt = (lo + hi) / 2
      if (!roots.some(q => Math.abs(q - rt) < 1e-4)) roots.push(rt)
    }
  }
  steps.push({ t: 'المعادلة ليست كثيرة حدود من الدرجة ≤ 2، فنبحث عن الجذور عددياً في المجال [−100, 100] (تقريبي):' })
  steps.push({ t: roots.length ? roots.map(q => `${v} ≈ ${fm(q)}`).join('\n') : 'لم أجد جذوراً في هذا المجال.', mono: true })
  return steps
}

function solveLocal(raw: string): Step[] {
  const s = raw.trim().replace(/×/g, '*').replace(/÷/g, '/').replace(/−/g, '-')
  if (!s) return [{ t: 'اكتب معادلة أو تعبيراً أولاً.' }]
  if (/(\band\b|\bor\b|\bnot\b|\bxor\b|->|=>|<->|∧|∨|¬|→|↔|&&|\|\||!\s*[A-Za-z(])/i.test(s)) return solveLogic(s)
  const d = s.match(/^d\/d([a-z])\s+(.+)$/i)
  if (d) {
    const node = derivative(d[2], d[1])
    return [
      { t: `نشتق ${d[2]} بالنسبة إلى ${d[1]}، مستخدمين قواعد الاشتقاق (القوة، الجداء، السلسلة).` },
      { t: `المشتقة: ${node.toString()}`, mono: true },
      { t: `بعد التبسيط: ${simplify(node).toString()}`, mono: true },
    ]
  }
  if (/[<>≤≥]/.test(s)) return [{ t: 'المتباينات لا يحلّها المحلّل المحلي. ظلّلها في أداة «الإحداثيات»، أو استخدم زر الذكاء الاصطناعي.' }]
  if (s.includes('=')) return solveEquation(s)
  const vars = freeVars(s)
  if (!vars.length) return [{ t: `نحسب التعبير: ${s}` }, { t: `الناتج = ${format(evaluate(s), { precision: 14 })}`, mono: true }]
  return [{ t: `نبسّط التعبير: ${s}` }, { t: simplify(s).toString(), mono: true }]
}

const EXAMPLES = ['x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0', '2x + 3 = 11', 'd/dx x^3 * sin(x)', '(2 + 3)^2 / 5', 'p and (p -> q)', '(p or q) and not p']

export default function AIMathSolver() {
  const [input, setInput] = useState('x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0')
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState<Step[]>([])
  const [ai, setAi] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const solve = () => {
    setAi('')
    try { setSteps(solveLocal(input)) } catch (e) { setSteps([{ t: 'تعذّر الحل المحلي: ' + (e as Error).message }]) }
  }
  const explain = async () => {
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      setAi(await askAI('math', `حلّ المسألة التالية بالتفصيل خطوة بخطوة مع شرح كل خطوة باللغة العربية، ثم اذكر الجواب النهائي بوضوح:\n${input}`))
    } catch (e) { setAi((e as Error).message) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-3">
      <textarea
        value={input} onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)} rows={3} dir="ltr"
        placeholder="x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0   |   d/dx x^3   |   p and (q -> p)"
        className={`${field} w-full font-mono`}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
        {EXAMPLES.map(x => <button key={x} className="rounded-full bg-white/10 px-3 py-0.5 text-xs hover:bg-white/20" dir="ltr" onClick={() => setInput(x)}>{x}</button>)}
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button className={btn} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }} onClick={solve}>حل خطوة بخطوة</button>
        <button className={btn} disabled={busy || !input.trim()} onClick={explain} title={hasAI() ? '' : 'يحتاج AI_ENDPOINT'}>
          {busy ? 'جارٍ الشرح…' : 'شرح بالذكاء الاصطناعي'}
        </button>
      </div>
      {!hasAI() && <p className="text-xs opacity-60">زر الذكاء الاصطناعي يحتاج رابط خادم في AI_ENDPOINT (ملف toolkit.ts). الحل المحلي يعمل بدونه.</p>}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {steps.map((s, i) => (
          <motion.div key={i} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.06 }} className={`${panel} p-3 text-sm`}>
            <span className="ml-2 font-semibold" style={{ color: ACCENT }}>{i + 1}.</span>
            {s.mono ? <pre className="mt-1 overflow-x-auto font-mono" dir="ltr">{s.t}</pre> : s.t}
          </motion.div>
        ))}
        {ai && <div className={`${panel} whitespace-pre-wrap p-3 text-sm`}>{ai}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { Library, Settings, UserRound } from 'lucide-react'
import { useAuth } from '../lib/supabase'
import { sfx } from '../shared'
import AuthModal from './AuthModal'

const str = (v: unknown): string => (typeof v === 'string' ? v : '')

/* ============ شارة الحساب: صورة المستخدم أو حالة الزائر ============ */
function ProfileBadge({ accent, onClick }: { accent: string; onClick: () => void }) {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth()
  const [broken, setBroken] = useState(false)
  const meta = user?.user_metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
  const avatar = str(meta?.avatar_url) || str(meta?.picture)
  const name = str(meta?.full_name) || user?.email?.split('@')[0] || ''

  useEffect(() => { setBroken(false) }, [avatar]) // نعيد المحاولة عند تغيّر الصورة

  if (loading) return <div className="h-9 w-9 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-white/10" aria-label="جارٍ التحقق من الحساب" />

  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => { sfx.click(); onClick() }}
      aria-label={user ? `حسابك: ${name}` : 'زائر، انقر لتسجيل الدخول'}
      title={user?.email ?? 'تسجيل الدخول'}
      className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/5 py-1 pe-3 ps-1 transition hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95"
    >
      {user ? (
        avatar && !broken ? (
          <img src={avatar} alt="" onError={() => setBroken(true)} className="h-7 w-7 rounded-full object-cover" style={{ boxShadow: `0 0 0 2px ${accent}` }} />
        ) : (
          <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-sm font-bold text-black" style={{ background: accent }}>
            {(name[0] ?? '?').toUpperCase()}
          </span>
        )
      ) : (
        <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10"><UserRound size={15} /></span>
      )}
      <span className="hidden max-w-28 truncate text-xs sm:inline">{user ? name : 'زائر'}</span>
    </button>
  )
}

/* ============ الترويسة العلوية ============ */
interface Props {
  accent: string
  onOpenSettings: () => void
}

export default function AppHeader({ accent, onOpenSettings }: Props) {
  const [authOpen, setAuthOpen] = useState(false)

  return (
    <>
      <header className="glass sticky top-0 z-20 rounded-none border-x-0 border-t-0">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-6xl items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 sm:px-5">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <span
              className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-black shadow-glow"
              style={{ background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${accent}, #8b5cf6)` }}
            >
              <Library size={18} />
            </span>
            <h1 className="font-kufi truncate bg-gradient-to-l from-violet-300 via-white to-sky-300 bg-clip-text text-lg font-bold text-transparent sm:text-xl">
              المكتبة النموذجية
            </h1>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              aria-label="الإعدادات"
              aria-haspopup="dialog"
              title="الإعدادات"
              onClick={() => { sfx.open(); onOpenSettings() }}
              className="group flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/5 transition hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95"
            >
              <Settings size={17} className="transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:rotate-90" />
            </button>
            <ProfileBadge accent={accent} onClick={() => setAuthOpen(true)} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <AuthModal open={authOpen} onClose={() => setAuthOpen(false)} />
    </>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Pause, Play, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react'
import { ACCENT, btn, field, panel } from './toolkit'

/* ============ مؤقت بومودورو ============ */
type ModeId = 'focus' | 'short' | 'long'
const MODES: { id: ModeId; label: string }[] = [{ id: 'focus', label: 'تركيز' }, { id: 'short', label: 'استراحة قصيرة' }, { id: 'long', label: 'استراحة طويلة' }]

function chime() {
  try {
    const c = new AudioContext()
    ;[660, 880, 1100].forEach((f, i) => {
      const o = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain(), t = c.currentTime + i * 0.25
      o.frequency.value = f
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.15, t + 0.03); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.6)
      o.connect(g).connect(c.destination); o.start(t); o.stop(t + 0.7)
    })
    setTimeout(() => c.close(), 1800)
  } catch { /* الصوت غير متاح */ }
}

/* ============ الأجواء الفضائية (مولَّدة بالكود بدون ملفات صوت) ============ */
type Kind = 'drone' | 'wind' | 'stars'
const KINDS: { id: Kind; label: string }[] = [{ id: 'drone', label: 'فضاء عميق' }, { id: 'wind', label: 'رياح كونية' }, { id: 'stars', label: 'نبضات نجمية' }]

function build(kind: Kind, ctx: AudioContext, out: AudioNode): () => void {
  const stops: (() => void)[] = []
  if (kind === 'drone') {
    const lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = 'lowpass'; lp.frequency.value = 380; lp.connect(out)
    const lfo = ctx.createOscillator(); lfo.frequency.value = 0.06
    const lg = ctx.createGain(); lg.gain.value = 160
    lfo.connect(lg); lg.connect(lp.frequency); lfo.start()
    ;[55, 82.41, 110.3, 164.8].forEach((f, i) => {
      const o = ctx.createOscillator(); o.type = i % 2 ? 'triangle' : 'sine'; o.frequency.value = f; o.detune.value = (i - 1.5) * 6
      const g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.12
      o.connect(g); g.connect(lp); o.start(); stops.push(() => o.stop())
    })
    stops.push(() => lfo.stop())
  } else if (kind === 'wind') {
    const len = ctx.sampleRate * 4, buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0)
    let last = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) { last = (last + 0.02 * (Math.random() * 2 - 1)) / 1.02; d[i] = last * 3.5 } // ضوضاء بنية ناعمة
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf; src.loop = true
    const lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = 'lowpass'; lp.frequency.value = 520
    const g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.35
    const lfo = ctx.createOscillator(); lfo.frequency.value = 0.08
    const lg = ctx.createGain(); lg.gain.value = 0.2
    lfo.connect(lg); lg.connect(g.gain); lfo.start()
    src.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(out); src.start()
    stops.push(() => src.stop(), () => lfo.stop())
  } else {
    const dl = ctx.createDelay(1); dl.delayTime.value = 0.45
    const fb = ctx.createGain(); fb.gain.value = 0.45
    dl.connect(fb); fb.connect(dl); dl.connect(out)
    let timer = 0
    const ping = () => {
      const o = ctx.createOscillator(); o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = 500 + Math.random() * 1300
      const g = ctx.createGain(), t = ctx.currentTime
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.09, t + 0.02); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 1.6)
      o.connect(g); g.connect(out); g.connect(dl); o.start(t); o.stop(t + 1.7)
      timer = window.setTimeout(ping, 1200 + Math.random() * 3000)
    }
    ping()
    stops.push(() => clearTimeout(timer))
  }
  return () => stops.forEach(s => s())
}

export default function AudioTools() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ModeId>('focus')
  const [mins, setMins] = useState({ focus: 25, short: 5, long: 15 })
  const [left, setLeft] = useState(25 * 60)
  const [run, setRun] = useState(false)
  const [done, setDone] = useState(0)
  const end = useRef(0)
  const finishRef = useRef(() => {})
  const total = mins[mode] * 60

  const switchMode = (m: ModeId) => { setMode(m); setLeft(mins[m] * 60); setRun(false) }
  finishRef.current = () => {
    setRun(false); chime()
    if (mode === 'focus') { const n = done + 1; setDone(n); switchMode(n % 4 === 0 ? 'long' : 'short') } else switchMode('focus')
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!run) return
    const id = setInterval(() => { const l = Math.max(0, Math.round((end.current - Date.now()) / 1000)); setLeft(l); if (l === 0) finishRef.current() }, 250)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [run])

  const toggle = () => { if (!run) end.current = Date.now() + left * 1000; setRun(r => !r) }
  const C = 2 * Math.PI * 70

  // محرك الصوت
  const ctxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null)
  const master = useRef<GainNode | null>(null)
  const live = useRef<Partial<Record<Kind, () => void>>>({})
  const [active, setActive] = useState<Kind[]>([])
  const [vol, setVol] = useState(0.6)

  const toggleKind = (k: Kind) => {
    if (live.current[k]) { live.current[k]!(); delete live.current[k]; return setActive(a => a.filter(x => x !== k)) }
    if (!ctxRef.current) { ctxRef.current = new AudioContext(); master.current = ctxRef.current.createGain(); master.current.gain.value = vol; master.current.connect(ctxRef.current.destination) }
    ctxRef.current.resume()
    live.current[k] = build(k, ctxRef.current, master.current!)
    setActive(a => [...a, k])
  }
  useEffect(() => { master.current?.gain.setTargetAtTime(vol, ctxRef.current?.currentTime ?? 0, 0.1) }, [vol])
  useEffect(() => () => { Object.values(live.current).forEach(s => s?.()); ctxRef.current?.close() }, [])

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-4">
      <div className={`${panel} space-y-4 p-4 text-center`}>
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-2">
          {MODES.map(m => <button key={m.id} className={btn} onClick={() => switchMode(m.id)} style={mode === m.id ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>{m.label}</button>)}
        </div>
        <div className="relative mx-auto h-44 w-44">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 160 160" className="h-full w-full -rotate-90">
            <circle cx={80} cy={80} r={70} fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.1)" strokeWidth={8} />
            <motion.circle cx={80} cy={80} r={70} fill="none" stroke={ACCENT} strokeWidth={8} strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={C} animate={{ strokeDashoffset: C * (1 - left / total) }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }} />
          </svg>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-4xl font-semibold tabular-nums" dir="ltr">{String(Math.floor(left / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:{String(left % 60).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
            <span className="text-xs opacity-60">جلسات منجزة: {done}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-2">
          <button className={btn} onClick={toggle} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }}>{run ? <><Pause size={14} className="ml-1 inline" />إيقاف مؤقت</> : <><Play size={14} className="ml-1 inline" />ابدأ</>}</button>
          <button className={btn} onClick={() => switchMode(mode)}><RotateCcw size={14} className="ml-1 inline" />إعادة</button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-3 text-xs">
          {MODES.map(m => (
            <label key={m.id}>{m.label}
              <input type="number" min={1} max={120} value={mins[m.id]} className={`${field} mr-1 w-14`}
                onChange={e => { const v = Math.max(1, +e.target.value || 1); setMins(x => ({ ...x, [m.id]: v })); if (m.id === mode && !run) setLeft(v * 60) }} />
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={`${panel} space-y-3 p-4`}>
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold">أجواء فضائية للتركيز</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {KINDS.map(k => <button key={k.id} className={btn} onClick={() => toggleKind(k.id)} style={active.includes(k.id) ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>{k.label}</button>)}
        </div>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">مستوى الصوت
          <input type="range" min={0} max={1} step={0.05} value={vol} onChange={e => setVol(+e.target.value)} className="flex-1" />
        </label>
        <p className="text-xs opacity-60">الأصوات مولَّدة بالكود (Web Audio)، ويمكن تشغيل أكثر من جو معاً.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

File: src/components/AuthModal.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { FormEvent } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { LogOut, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { isSupabaseConfigured, signInWithEmail, signOutUser, signUpWithEmail, useAuth } from '../lib/supabase'
import { sfx } from '../shared'
import { ACCENT, btn, field } from './toolkit'

type Mode = 'signin' | 'signup'

interface Props {
  open: boolean
  onClose: () => void
}

export default function AuthModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth()
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('signin')
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [info, setInfo] = useState('')

  // تصفير النموذج في كل مرة تُفتح فيها النافذة
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    setMode('signin')
    setEmail('')
    setPassword('')
    setConfirm('')
    setError('')
    setInfo('')
    setBusy(false)
  }, [open])

  // الإغلاق بمفتاح Esc
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        sfx.close()
        onClose()
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [open, onClose])

  const switchMode = (m: Mode): void => {
    setMode(m)
    setError('')
    setInfo('')
    setPassword('')
    setConfirm('')
  }

  const submit = async (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>): Promise<void> => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setError('')
    setInfo('')
    const mail = email.trim()
    if (!mail || !password) {
      setError('أدخل البريد الإلكتروني وكلمة المرور')
      return
    }
    if (mode === 'signup') {
      if (password.length < 6) {
        setError('كلمة المرور يجب أن تكون 6 أحرف على الأقل')
        return
      }
      if (password !== confirm) {
        setError('كلمتا المرور غير متطابقتين')
        return
      }
    }
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const res = mode === 'signin' ? await signInWithEmail(mail, password) : await signUpWithEmail(mail, password)
      if (res.error) {
        setError(res.error)
        return
      }
      if (res.needsConfirmation) {
        setInfo('تم إنشاء الحساب. افتح رسالة التأكيد في بريدك ثم سجّل الدخول.')
        setMode('signin')
        setPassword('')
        setConfirm('')
        return
      }
      sfx.success()
      onClose() // نجح الدخول: تتحدّث الحالة تلقائياً عبر مستمع الجلسة
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const handleSignOut = async (): Promise<void> => {
    setBusy(true)
    const res = await signOutUser()
    setBusy(false)
    if (res.error) {
      setError(res.error)
      return
    }
    sfx.close()
    onClose()
  }

  const tab = (m: Mode): React.CSSProperties => (mode === m ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {})

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="auth-modal"
          className="fixed inset-0 z-40 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
        >
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm"
            onClick={() => {
              sfx.close()
              onClose()
            }}
          />
          <motion.div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="تسجيل الدخول"
            dir="rtl"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.98 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            className="relative w-full max-w-sm space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0f1219]/90 p-5 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold" style={{ color: ACCENT }}>
                {user ? 'حسابك' : mode === 'signin' ? 'تسجيل الدخول' : 'إنشاء حساب'}
              </h2>
              <button
                aria-label="إغلاق"
                onClick={() => {
                  sfx.close()
                  onClose()
                }}
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>

            {!isSupabaseConfigured ? (
              /* وضع الزائر: المفاتيح غير مضبوطة */
              <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                <p>أنت الآن في وضع الزائر، وكل ميزات التطبيق تعمل محلياً.</p>
                <p className="opacity-70">لتفعيل الحسابات والمزامنة السحابية:</p>
                <ol className="list-decimal space-y-1 pr-5 opacity-80">
                  <li>أنشئ مشروعاً في Supabase.</li>
                  <li>
                    أضف <span dir="ltr">VITE_SUPABASE_URL</span> و<span dir="ltr">VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY</span> في ملف <span dir="ltr">.env</span>.
                  </li>
                  <li>شغّل سكربت SQL من SQL Editor.</li>
                  <li>أعد تشغيل خادم التطوير.</li>
                </ol>
              </div>
            ) : loading ? (
              <p className="py-4 text-center text-sm opacity-70">جارٍ التحقق من الجلسة…</p>
            ) : user ? (
              /* مستخدم مسجّل */
              <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
                <p>
                  أنت مسجّل الدخول بالبريد:
                  <br />
                  <b className="break-all" dir="ltr">{user.email}</b>
                </p>
                {error && <p role="alert" className="text-red-300">{error}</p>}
                <button className={`${btn} flex items-center gap-2`} disabled={busy} onClick={handleSignOut}>
                  <LogOut size={14} />
                  {busy ? 'جارٍ الخروج…' : 'تسجيل الخروج'}
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              /* نموذج الدخول / إنشاء حساب */
              <>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button type="button" className={btn} style={tab('signin')} onClick={() => switchMode('signin')}>
                    دخول
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" className={btn} style={tab('signup')} onClick={() => switchMode('signup')}>
                    حساب جديد
                  </button>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-3" noValidate>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label htmlFor="auth-email" className="text-sm opacity-80">البريد الإلكتروني</label>
                    <input
                      id="auth-email"
                      type="email"
                      dir="ltr"
                      autoComplete="email"
                      value={email}
                      onChange={ev => setEmail(ev.target.value)}
                      className={`${field} w-full`}
                      placeholder="name@example.com"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label htmlFor="auth-password" className="text-sm opacity-80">كلمة المرور</label>
                    <input
                      id="auth-password"
                      type="password"
                      dir="ltr"
                      autoComplete={mode === 'signin' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password'}
                      value={password}
                      onChange={ev => setPassword(ev.target.value)}
                      className={`${field} w-full`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  {mode === 'signup' && (
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <label htmlFor="auth-confirm" className="text-sm opacity-80">تأكيد كلمة المرور</label>
                      <input
                        id="auth-confirm"
                        type="password"
                        dir="ltr"
                        autoComplete="new-password"
                        value={confirm}
                        onChange={ev => setConfirm(ev.target.value)}
                        className={`${field} w-full`}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-red-300">{error}</p>}
                  {info && <p role="status" className="text-sm" style={{ color: ACCENT }}>{info}</p>}

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={busy}
                    className="w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-black transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-60"
                    style={{ background: ACCENT }}
                  >
                    {busy ? 'يرجى الانتظار…' : mode === 'signin' ? 'تسجيل الدخول' : 'إنشاء الحساب'}
                  </button>
                </form>
              </>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

File: src/components/Calculator.tsx

import { useState } from 'react'
import { evaluate, format } from 'mathjs'
import { ACCENT, btn, copy, field, panel } from './toolkit'

/* ============ الحاسبة العلمية ============ */
const D = Math.PI / 180
// في وضع الدرجات نستبدل الدوال المثلثية بنسخ تعمل بالدرجات
const degScope = {
  sin: (x: number) => Math.sin(x * D), cos: (x: number) => Math.cos(x * D), tan: (x: number) => Math.tan(x * D),
  asin: (x: number) => Math.asin(x) / D, acos: (x: number) => Math.acos(x) / D, atan: (x: number) => Math.atan(x) / D,
}
const KEYS: [string, string][] = [
  ['sin', 'sin('], ['cos', 'cos('], ['tan', 'tan('], ['(', '('], [')', ')'],
  ['asin', 'asin('], ['acos', 'acos('], ['atan', 'atan('], ['π', 'pi'], ['e', 'e'],
  ['log', 'log10('], ['ln', 'log('], ['√', 'sqrt('], ['xʸ', '^'], ['n!', '!'],
  ['7', '7'], ['8', '8'], ['9', '9'], ['÷', '/'], ['abs', 'abs('],
  ['4', '4'], ['5', '5'], ['6', '6'], ['×', '*'], ['mod', ' mod '],
  ['1', '1'], ['2', '2'], ['3', '3'], ['−', '-'], ['x²', '^2'],
  ['0', '0'], ['.', '.'], ['ans', 'ans'], ['+', '+'], ['10ˣ', '10^('],
]

function Scientific() {
  const [expr, setExpr] = useState('')
  const [res, setRes] = useState('')
  const [deg, setDeg] = useState(true)
  const [ans, setAns] = useState(0)
  const [hist, setHist] = useState<{ e: string; r: string }[]>([])

  const run = () => {
    if (!expr.trim()) return
    try {
      const v = evaluate(expr, { ...(deg ? degScope : {}), ans })
      const s = format(v, { precision: 12 })
      setRes(s)
      if (typeof v === 'number') setAns(v)
      setHist(h => [{ e: expr, r: s }, ...h].slice(0, 20))
    } catch {
      setRes('خطأ في التعبير')
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className={`${panel} p-3`} dir="ltr">
        <input
          value={expr}
          onChange={e => setExpr(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && run()}
          placeholder="sin(30) + 2^3 / sqrt(16)"
          className={`${field} w-full text-lg`}
        />
        <button onClick={() => copy(res)} className="mt-2 block min-h-8 w-full text-right text-2xl font-semibold" style={{ color: ACCENT }} title="انقر للنسخ">
          {res || '0'}
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button className={btn} onClick={run} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }}>=</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => { setExpr(''); setRes('') }}>مسح</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setExpr(e => e.slice(0, -1))}>⌫</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setDeg(d => !d)}>{deg ? 'درجات DEG' : 'راديان RAD'}</button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2" dir="ltr">
        {KEYS.map(([l, ins]) => (
          <button key={l} className={`${btn} py-2.5`} onClick={() => setExpr(e => e + ins)}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {hist.length > 0 && (
        <ul className={`${panel} max-h-40 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 text-sm`} dir="ltr">
          {hist.map((h, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <button className="w-full text-left opacity-80 hover:opacity-100" onClick={() => setExpr(h.e)}>
                {h.e} = <b style={{ color: ACCENT }}>{h.r}</b>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/* ============ حاسبة المبرمجين (أعداد صحيحة 64 بت) ============ */
const BASES = [{ n: 16, l: 'HEX' }, { n: 10, l: 'DEC' }, { n: 8, l: 'OCT' }, { n: 2, l: 'BIN' }]

function parseBig(s: string, base: number): bigint | null {
  const t = s.trim().toLowerCase()
  const neg = t.startsWith('-')
  const body = neg ? t.slice(1) : t
  if (!body) return null
  let v = 0n
  for (const ch of body) {
    const d = '0123456789abcdef'.indexOf(ch)
    if (d < 0 || d >= base) return null
    v = v * BigInt(base) + BigInt(d)
  }
  return neg ? -v : v
}
// القيم السالبة تظهر بمتمّم الاثنين (64 بت) في غير النظام العشري
const show = (v: bigint, b: number) => (v < 0n && b !== 10 ? BigInt.asUintN(64, v) : v).toString(b).toUpperCase()

const OPS: [string, (a: bigint, b: bigint) => bigint | null][] = [
  ['+', (a, b) => a + b], ['−', (a, b) => a - b], ['×', (a, b) => a * b],
  ['÷', (a, b) => (b === 0n ? null : a / b)], ['%', (a, b) => (b === 0n ? null : a % b)],
  ['AND', (a, b) => a & b], ['OR', (a, b) => a | b], ['XOR', (a, b) => a ^ b],
  ['<<', (a, b) => (b < 0n || b > 63n ? null : a << b)], ['>>', (a, b) => (b < 0n || b > 63n ? null : a >> b)],
]

function Programmer() {
  const [base, setBase] = useState(10)
  const [a, setA] = useState('255')
  const [b, setB] = useState('15')
  const [res, setRes] = useState<bigint | null>(null)
  const [err, setErr] = useState('')
  const A = parseBig(a, base)
  const B = parseBig(b, base)

  const apply = (fn: (x: bigint, y: bigint) => bigint | null) => {
    if (A === null || B === null) return setErr('أدخل قيمتين صحيحتين بالنظام المختار')
    const r = fn(A, B)
    if (r === null) return setErr('عملية غير مسموحة (قسمة على صفر أو إزاحة خارج 0–63)')
    setErr('')
    setRes(BigInt.asIntN(64, r))
  }
  const table = (v: bigint | null) => (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm" dir="ltr">
      {BASES.map(x => (
        <button key={x.n} className={`${panel} px-3 py-2 text-left`} onClick={() => v !== null && copy(show(v, x.n))} title="انقر للنسخ">
          <span className="opacity-60">{x.l} </span>
          <span className="break-all font-mono">{v === null ? '—' : show(v, x.n)}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        {BASES.map(x => (
          <button key={x.n} onClick={() => setBase(x.n)} className={btn} style={base === x.n ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>{x.l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2" dir="ltr">
        <label className="space-y-1 text-sm">A<input value={a} onChange={e => setA(e.target.value)} className={`${field} w-full font-mono`} /></label>
        <label className="space-y-1 text-sm">B<input value={b} onChange={e => setB(e.target.value)} className={`${field} w-full font-mono`} /></label>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2" dir="ltr">
        {OPS.map(([l, fn]) => <button key={l} className={btn} onClick={() => apply(fn)}>{l}</button>)}
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => (A === null ? setErr('A غير صحيحة') : (setErr(''), setRes(BigInt.asIntN(64, ~A))))}>NOT A</button>
      </div>
      {err && <p className="text-sm text-red-300">{err}</p>}
      <div className="space-y-1"><p className="text-sm opacity-70">قيمة A بكل الأنظمة</p>{table(A)}</div>
      <div className="space-y-1"><p className="text-sm opacity-70">النتيجة</p>{table(res)}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function Calculator() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'sci' | 'prog'>('sci')
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-3">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setMode('sci')} style={mode === 'sci' ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>علمية</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setMode('prog')} style={mode === 'prog' ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>مبرمجين</button>
      </div>
      {mode === 'sci' ? <Scientific /> : <Programmer />}
    </div>
  )
}

================
File: src/components/CodePlayground.tsx
================
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Copy, Download, Play } from 'lucide-react'
import { ACCENT, btn, copy, download, panel, usePersisted } from './toolkit'

type Lang = 'py' | 'cpp'
const TEMPLATES: Record<Lang, string> = {
  py: '# مثال: أعداد أولية حتى 30\nprimes = [n for n in range(2, 30) if all(n % d for d in range(2, int(n ** 0.5) + 1))]\nprint("الأعداد الأولية:", primes)\n',
  cpp: '#include <iostream>\nusing namespace std;\n\nint main() {\n    int sum = 0;\n    for (int i = 1; i <= 10; i++) sum += i;\n    cout << "Sum = " << sum << endl;\n    return 0;\n}\n',
}
const KW: Record<Lang, string> = {
  py: 'def|class|if|elif|else|for|while|return|import|from|in|not|and|or|print|True|False|None|range|len|try|except|with|as|lambda',
  cpp: 'int|long|double|float|char|bool|void|if|else|for|while|return|include|using|namespace|std|cout|cin|endl|class|struct|const|auto|vector|string|new|delete',
}

// تلوين بسيط: تعليقات، نصوص، كلمات مفتاحية، أرقام (تمريرة واحدة فلا يتداخل التلوين)
function highlight(code: string, lang: Lang) {
  const esc = code.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
  const cm = lang === 'py' ? '#.*' : '\\/\\/.*'
  const re = new RegExp(`(${cm})|("(?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*"|'(?:[^'\\\\]|\\\\.)*')|\\b(${KW[lang]})\\b|\\b(\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\b`, 'g')
  return esc.replace(re, (m, c, s, k, n) =>
    `<span style="color:${c ? '#7c8294' : s ? '#86efac' : k ? '#c4b5fd' : n ? '#fcd34d' : 'inherit'}">${m}</span>`)
}

// تحميل بيئة Python (Pyodide) عند أول تشغيل فقط
let pyPromise: Promise<any> | null = null
function loadPy(): Promise<any> {
  pyPromise ??= new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const s = document.createElement('script')
    s.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.26.4/full/pyodide.js'
    s.onload = () => (window as any).loadPyodide().then(res, rej)
    s.onerror = () => { pyPromise = null; rej(new Error('تعذّر تحميل بيئة Python (تحتاج اتصالاً بالإنترنت)')) }
    document.head.appendChild(s)
  })
  return pyPromise
}

export default function CodePlayground() {
  const [lang, setLang] = useState<Lang>('py')
  const [codes, setCodes] = usePersisted<Record<Lang, string>>('atelier-code-v1', TEMPLATES)
  const [out, setOut] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const pre = useRef<HTMLPreElement>(null)
  const gut = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const code = codes[lang]
  const setCode = (v: string) => setCodes(c => ({ ...c, [lang]: v }))

  const run = async () => {
    if (lang === 'cpp') return setOut('تشغيل C++ غير متاح داخل المتصفح بدون خادم تجميع. يمكنك التعديل والحفظ والتنزيل ثم تجميعه على جهازك.')
    setBusy(true)
    setOut('جارٍ التشغيل… (أول مرة يحمّل البيئة وقد يستغرق ثوانٍ)')
    try {
      const py = await loadPy()
      let buf = ''
      py.setStdout({ batched: (m: string) => { buf += m + '\n' } })
      py.setStderr({ batched: (m: string) => { buf += m + '\n' } })
      try { await py.runPythonAsync(code) } catch (e) { buf += String(e) }
      setOut(buf || '(لا يوجد ناتج)')
    } catch (e) { setOut((e as Error).message) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {(['py', 'cpp'] as Lang[]).map(l => (
          <button key={l} className={btn} onClick={() => setLang(l)} style={lang === l ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>{l === 'py' ? 'Python' : 'C++'}</button>
        ))}
        <button className={`${btn} mr-auto`} onClick={() => copy(code)}><Copy size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />نسخ</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => download(lang === 'py' ? 'main.py' : 'main.cpp', code)}><Download size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />تنزيل</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setCode(TEMPLATES[lang])}>مثال جاهز</button>
        <button className={btn} disabled={busy} onClick={run} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }}><Play size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />تشغيل</button>
      </div>

      <div className={`${panel} relative h-80 overflow-hidden font-mono text-[13px] leading-5`} dir="ltr">
        <div ref={gut} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 top-0 w-10 select-none py-3 pr-2 text-right opacity-40">
          {code.split('\n').map((_, i) => <div key={i}>{i + 1}</div>)}
        </div>
        <pre ref={pre} aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute left-10 top-0 m-0 min-w-full whitespace-pre p-3" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: highlight(code, lang) + '\n' }} />
        <textarea
          value={code} spellCheck={false} wrap="off"
          onChange={e => setCode(e.target.value)}
          onScroll={e => {
            const t = e.currentTarget
            if (pre.current) pre.current.style.transform = `translate(${-t.scrollLeft}px,${-t.scrollTop}px)`
            if (gut.current) gut.current.style.transform = `translateY(${-t.scrollTop}px)`
          }}
          onKeyDown={e => {
            if (e.key !== 'Tab') return
            e.preventDefault()
            const t = e.currentTarget
            t.setRangeText('    ', t.selectionStart, t.selectionEnd, 'end')
            setCode(t.value)
          }}
          className="absolute inset-0 left-10 h-full w-[calc(100%-2.5rem)] resize-none overflow-auto whitespace-pre bg-transparent p-3 text-transparent caret-white outline-none"
        />
      </div>

      <pre className={`${panel} min-h-16 whitespace-pre-wrap p-3 font-mono text-sm`}>{out || 'الناتج يظهر هنا'}</pre>
      <p className="text-xs opacity-60">Python يعمل فعلاً داخل المتصفح (بدون input()). كودك يُحفظ تلقائياً.</p>
    </div>
  )
}

File: src/components/CoordinateSystem.tsx

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { PointerEvent as RPointerEvent } from 'react'
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { compile } from 'mathjs'
import type { EvalFunction } from 'mathjs'
import { Plus, RotateCcw, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { ACCENT, btn, field, panel } from './toolkit'

const W = 800
const H = 500
const COLORS = ['#a78bfa', '#67e8f9', '#f9a8d4', '#fcd34d', '#86efac', '#fdba74']
const num = (v: unknown) => (typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? v : NaN)

type Rel = '=' | '<' | '>' | '<=' | '>='
type Parsed = { kind: 'fn'; f: EvalFunction } | { kind: 'rel'; g: EvalFunction; rel: Rel } | { kind: 'none' }

// y = f(x) يُرسم كمنحنى، وأي علاقة أخرى (متباينة أو معادلة ضمنية) تُرسم بالعينات
function parseLine(line: string): Parsed {
  const s = line.replace(/≤/g, '<=').replace(/≥/g, '>=').trim()
  if (!s) return { kind: 'none' }
  try {
    const m = s.match(/^(.*?)(<=|>=|<|>|=)(.*)$/)
    if (!m) return { kind: 'fn', f: compile(s) }
    const [, l, op, r] = m
    if (op === '=' && l.trim() === 'y') return { kind: 'fn', f: compile(r) }
    return { kind: 'rel', g: compile(`(${l}) - (${r})`), rel: op as Rel }
  } catch {
    return { kind: 'none' }
  }
}

/* ============ المستوى الثنائي XY ============ */
function Plot2D({ lines }: { lines: string[] }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null)
  const [view, setView] = useState({ cx: 0, cy: 0, k: 40 })
  const drag = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null)
  const parsed = useMemo(() => lines.map(parseLine), [lines])

  useEffect(() => {
    const cv = ref.current
    if (!cv) return
    const c = cv.getContext('2d')!
    const { cx, cy, k } = view
    const X = (x: number) => W / 2 + (x - cx) * k
    const Y = (y: number) => H / 2 - (y - cy) * k
    const wx = (px: number) => cx + (px - W / 2) / k
    const wy = (py: number) => cy - (py - H / 2) / k

    c.fillStyle = '#0f1219'
    c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H)
    // الشبكة
    const raw = 70 / k
    const mag = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw))
    const step = [1, 2, 5, 10].map(m => m * mag).find(s => s >= raw)!
    c.font = '11px sans-serif'
    c.lineWidth = 1
    for (let x = Math.ceil(wx(0) / step) * step; x <= wx(W); x += step) {
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.07)'
      c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(X(x), 0); c.lineTo(X(x), H); c.stroke()
      if (Math.abs(x) > step / 2) { c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.45)'; c.fillText(String(+x.toPrecision(6)), X(x) + 3, Math.min(H - 4, Math.max(12, Y(0) + 13))) }
    }
    for (let y = Math.ceil(wy(H) / step) * step; y <= wy(0); y += step) {
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.07)'
      c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(0, Y(y)); c.lineTo(W, Y(y)); c.stroke()
      if (Math.abs(y) > step / 2) { c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.45)'; c.fillText(String(+y.toPrecision(6)), Math.min(W - 30, Math.max(4, X(0) + 4)), Y(y) - 3) }
    }
    c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.55)'
    c.lineWidth = 1.5
    c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(X(0), 0); c.lineTo(X(0), H); c.moveTo(0, Y(0)); c.lineTo(W, Y(0)); c.stroke()

    parsed.forEach((p, i) => {
      const col = COLORS[i % COLORS.length]
      if (p.kind === 'fn') {
        c.strokeStyle = col; c.lineWidth = 2.2; c.beginPath()
        const sc = { x: 0 }
        let pen = false, prev = 0
        for (let px = 0; px <= W; px += 1.5) {
          sc.x = wx(px)
          let y = NaN
          try { y = num(p.f.evaluate(sc)) } catch { /* خارج المجال */ }
          const py = Y(y)
          if (!isFinite(py) || Math.abs(py) > 5000 || (pen && Math.abs(py - prev) > H * 1.5)) { pen = false; continue }
          if (pen) c.lineTo(px, py); else { c.moveTo(px, py); pen = true }
          prev = py
        }
        c.stroke()
      } else if (p.kind === 'rel') {
        const S = 5, nx = Math.ceil(W / S), ny = Math.ceil(H / S), st = nx + 1
        const sc = { x: 0, y: 0 }
        const vals = new Float64Array(st * (ny + 1))
        for (let j = 0; j <= ny; j++) for (let a = 0; a <= nx; a++) {
          sc.x = wx(a * S); sc.y = wy(j * S)
          let v = NaN
          try { v = num(p.g.evaluate(sc)) } catch { /* خارج المجال */ }
          vals[j * st + a] = v
        }
        const ok = (v: number) => (p.rel === '<' ? v < 0 : p.rel === '>' ? v > 0 : p.rel === '<=' ? v <= 0 : p.rel === '>=' ? v >= 0 : false)
        if (p.rel !== '=') {
          c.fillStyle = col + '40' // التظليل
          for (let j = 0; j < ny; j++) for (let a = 0; a < nx; a++) { const v = vals[j * st + a]; if (!isNaN(v) && ok(v)) c.fillRect(a * S, j * S, S, S) }
        }
        c.fillStyle = col // الحدّ الفاصل: حيث تتغير إشارة القيمة
        for (let j = 0; j < ny; j++) for (let a = 0; a < nx; a++) {
          const v = vals[j * st + a], r = vals[j * st + a + 1], d = vals[(j + 1) * st + a]
          if (!isNaN(v) && ((!isNaN(r) && (v < 0) !== (r < 0)) || (!isNaN(d) && (v < 0) !== (d < 0)))) c.fillRect(a * S - 0.5, j * S - 0.5, 2.2, 2.2)
        }
      }
    })
  }, [view, parsed])

  // التكبير بالعجلة (مستمع أصلي حتى نمنع تمرير الصفحة)
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current!
    const h = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      setView(v => ({ ...v, k: Math.min(400, Math.max(4, v.k * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 1 / 1.12))) }))
    }
    el.addEventListener('wheel', h, { passive: false })
    return () => el.removeEventListener('wheel', h)
  }, [])

  const down = (e: RPointerEvent) => { drag.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; ref.current!.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) }
  const move = (e: RPointerEvent) => {
    const d = drag.current
    if (!d) return
    const s = W / ref.current!.getBoundingClientRect().width
    const dx = (e.clientX - d.x) * s, dy = (e.clientY - d.y) * s
    drag.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }
    setView(v => ({ ...v, cx: v.cx - dx / v.k, cy: v.cy + dy / v.k }))
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <canvas
        ref={ref} width={W} height={H}
        className="w-full cursor-grab touch-none rounded-lg border border-white/10"
        onPointerDown={down} onPointerMove={move} onPointerUp={() => { drag.current = null }}
      />
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs opacity-70">
        <span>اسحب للتحريك، وبالعجلة للتكبير</span>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setView({ cx: 0, cy: 0, k: 40 })}><RotateCcw size={12} className="ml-1 inline" />إعادة الضبط</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/* ============ السطح ثلاثي الأبعاد XYZ ============ */
function Surface({ fn }: { fn: EvalFunction }) {
  const geo = useMemo(() => {
    const R = 5, N = 64
    const g = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2 * R, 2 * R, N, N) // مستوى XY، والارتفاع z
    const p = g.attributes.position as THREE.BufferAttribute
    const zs: number[] = []
    const sc = { x: 0, y: 0 }
    for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
      sc.x = p.getX(i); sc.y = p.getY(i)
      let z = 0
      try { const v = num(fn.evaluate(sc)); z = isNaN(v) ? 0 : Math.max(-8, Math.min(8, v)) } catch { /* خارج المجال */ }
      zs.push(z)
      p.setZ(i, z)
    }
    const lo = Math.min(...zs), hi = Math.max(...zs)
    const col = new Float32Array(p.count * 3)
    const cc = new THREE.Color()
    zs.forEach((z, i) => { cc.setHSL(0.78 - 0.28 * ((z - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)), 0.7, 0.55); cc.toArray(col, i * 3) })
    g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col, 3))
    g.computeVertexNormals()
    return g
  }, [fn])
  useEffect(() => () => geo.dispose(), [geo])
  return (
    <mesh geometry={geo}>
      <meshStandardMaterial vertexColors side={THREE.DoubleSide} roughness={0.55} />
    </mesh>
  )
}

function Plot3D() {
  const [expr, setExpr] = useState('sin(x) * cos(y)')
  const [rot, setRot] = useState({ spin: 0.6, tilt: 0.7 })
  const drag = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null)
  const fn = useMemo(() => { try { return compile(expr.replace(/^\s*z\s*=/i, '')) } catch { return null } }, [expr])

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2" dir="ltr">
        <span className="text-sm opacity-70">z =</span>
        <input value={expr} onChange={e => setExpr(e.target.value)} className={`${field} flex-1`} placeholder="x^2 + y^2" />
      </div>
      {!fn && <p className="text-sm text-red-300">التعبير غير صالح</p>}
      <div
        className="h-[420px] cursor-grab touch-none overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-[#0f1219]"
        onPointerDown={e => { drag.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }; e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) }}
        onPointerMove={e => {
          const d = drag.current
          if (!d) return
          drag.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }
          setRot(r => ({ spin: r.spin + (e.clientX - d.x) * 0.01, tilt: Math.max(-0.2, Math.min(1.5, r.tilt + (e.clientY - d.y) * 0.01)) }))
        }}
        onPointerUp={() => { drag.current = null }}
      >
        <Canvas camera={{ position: [0, 4, 13], fov: 50 }}>
          <ambientLight intensity={0.6} />
          <directionalLight position={[5, 8, 6]} intensity={1.6} />
          <group rotation={[rot.tilt, 0, 0]}>
            <gridHelper args={[10, 10, '#6b5fa8', '#2a2f3d']} />
            <group rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, rot.spin]}>
              <axesHelper args={[6]} />
              {fn && <Surface fn={fn} />}
            </group>
          </group>
        </Canvas>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs opacity-70">اسحب لتدوير السطح. المدى من −5 إلى 5 في x وy.</p>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function CoordinateSystem() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'2d' | '3d'>('2d')
  const [lines, setLines] = useState(['y = x^2', 'y > 2x + 1'])
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setMode('2d')} style={mode === '2d' ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>ثنائي XY</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => setMode('3d')} style={mode === '3d' ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>ثلاثي XYZ</button>
      </div>
      {mode === '2d' ? (
        <>
          <div className={`${panel} space-y-2 p-3`} dir="ltr">
            {lines.map((l, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: COLORS[i % COLORS.length] }} />
                <input value={l} onChange={e => setLines(a => a.map((x, j) => (j === i ? e.target.value : x)))} className={`${field} flex-1`} placeholder="y = x^2   |   y > 2x + 1   |   x^2 + y^2 <= 9" />
                <button aria-label="حذف السطر" onClick={() => setLines(a => a.filter((_, j) => j !== i))}><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
              </div>
            ))}
            <button className={btn} onClick={() => setLines(a => [...a, ''])}><Plus size={14} className="ml-1 inline" />دالة أو متباينة</button>
          </div>
          <Plot2D lines={lines} />
        </>
      ) : <Plot3D />}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { FileUp } from 'lucide-react'
import { useLibrary } from '../shared'
import { ACCENT, btn, field, panel } from './toolkit'

type ChartType = 'bar' | 'line' | 'scatter' | 'pie'
const SERIES = ['#a78bfa', '#67e8f9', '#f9a8d4', '#fcd34d', '#86efac', '#fdba74']
const SAMPLE = 'الشهر,المبيعات,المصروفات\nيناير,120,80\nفبراير,150,90\nمارس,170,110\nأبريل,140,95\nمايو,200,130\nيونيو,230,150'
const toNum = (s?: string) => Number((s ?? '').replace(/,/g, '').trim())

// قارئ CSV يدعم الاقتباس والفاصلة والفاصلة المنقوطة والتاب
function parseCSV(t: string): string[][] {
  const first = t.split('\n')[0] ?? ''
  const d = first.includes('\t') ? '\t' : first.includes(';') && !first.includes(',') ? ';' : ','
  const rows: string[][] = []
  let row: string[] = [], cur = '', q = false
  const endRow = () => { row.push(cur); cur = ''; if (row.some(x => x.trim() !== '')) rows.push(row); row = [] }
  for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
    const c = t[i]
    if (q) { if (c === '"') { if (t[i + 1] === '"') { cur += '"'; i++ } else q = false } else cur += c }
    else if (c === '"') q = true
    else if (c === d) { row.push(cur); cur = '' }
    else if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') { if (c === '\r' && t[i + 1] === '\n') i++; endRow() }
    else cur += c
  }
  endRow()
  return rows
}

interface Ser { name: string; vals: number[] }

function Chart({ type, labels, series, xs }: { type: ChartType; labels: string[]; series: Ser[]; xs: number[] | null }) {
  const CW = 640, CH = 320, L = 52, R = 12, T = 12, B = 46
  const pw = CW - L - R, ph = CH - T - B
  const n = labels.length
  if (!n || !series.length) return <p className="py-10 text-center text-sm opacity-60">اختر عموداً رقمياً واحداً على الأقل للرسم</p>

  if (type === 'pie') {
    const s = series[0]
    const total = s.vals.reduce((a, v) => a + Math.max(0, v), 0) || 1
    let ang = -Math.PI / 2
    const cx = 160, cy = CH / 2, r = 120
    return (
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${CW} ${CH}`} className="w-full">
        {s.vals.map((v, i) => {
          const a2 = ang + (Math.max(0, v) / total) * Math.PI * 2
          const big = a2 - ang > Math.PI ? 1 : 0
          const d = `M${cx} ${cy} L${cx + r * Math.cos(ang)} ${cy + r * Math.sin(ang)} A${r} ${r} 0 ${big} 1 ${cx + r * Math.cos(a2)} ${cy + r * Math.sin(a2)}Z`
          ang = a2
          return <motion.path key={i} d={d} fill={SERIES[i % SERIES.length]} initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }}><title>{`${labels[i]}: ${v} (${((Math.max(0, v) / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`}</title></motion.path>
        })}
        {labels.slice(0, 12).map((l, i) => (
          <g key={i} transform={`translate(330 ${24 + i * 22})`}>
            <rect width={12} height={12} rx={3} fill={SERIES[i % SERIES.length]} />
            <text x={18} y={11} fontSize={12} fill="#cbd0dc">{l.slice(0, 22)}</text>
          </g>
        ))}
      </svg>
    )
  }

  const all = series.flatMap(s => s.vals).filter(isFinite)
  const lo = Math.min(0, ...all), hi = Math.max(...all, 1)
  const Y = (v: number) => T + ph * (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1))
  const xmin = xs ? Math.min(...xs) : 0, xmax = xs ? Math.max(...xs) : n - 1
  const X = (i: number) => (type === 'scatter' && xs ? L + pw * ((xs[i] - xmin) / (xmax - xmin || 1)) : L + (pw / n) * (i + 0.5))
  const bw = (pw / n) * 0.8 / series.length

  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${CW} ${CH}`} className="w-full">
      {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => {
        const v = lo + ((hi - lo) * i) / 4
        return <g key={i}><line x1={L} x2={CW - R} y1={Y(v)} y2={Y(v)} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.08)" /><text x={L - 6} y={Y(v) + 4} fontSize={10} fill="#9aa1b2" textAnchor="end">{+v.toPrecision(3)}</text></g>
      })}
      {labels.map((l, i) => (i % Math.ceil(n / 12) === 0 ? <text key={i} x={X(i)} y={CH - B + 16} fontSize={10} fill="#9aa1b2" textAnchor="middle">{l.slice(0, 10)}</text> : null))}
      {series.map((s, si) => {
        const col = SERIES[si % SERIES.length]
        if (type === 'bar') return s.vals.map((v, i) => (
          <motion.rect key={`${si}-${i}`} x={L + (pw / n) * i + (pw / n) * 0.1 + bw * si} y={Math.min(Y(v), Y(0))} width={bw} height={Math.abs(Y(v) - Y(0))} rx={2} fill={col}
            style={{ transformBox: 'fill-box', transformOrigin: 'bottom' }} initial={{ scaleY: 0 }} animate={{ scaleY: 1 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.02 }}><title>{`${labels[i]} — ${s.name}: ${v}`}</title></motion.rect>
        ))
        return (
          <g key={si}>
            {type === 'line' && <path d={s.vals.map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${X(i)} ${Y(v)}`).join('')} fill="none" stroke={col} strokeWidth={2.2} />}
            {s.vals.map((v, i) => <circle key={i} cx={X(i)} cy={Y(v)} r={type === 'scatter' ? 4 : 3.2} fill={col}><title>{`${labels[i]} — ${s.name}: ${v}`}</title></circle>)}
          </g>
        )
      })}
    </svg>
  )
}

export default function DataAnalyzer() {
  const { items } = useLibrary()
  const [text, setText] = useState(SAMPLE)
  const [type, setType] = useState<ChartType>('bar')
  const [xi, setXi] = useState(0)
  const [ys, setYs] = useState<number[]>([1, 2])

  const rows = useMemo(() => parseCSV(text), [text])
  const head = rows[0] ?? []
  const body = rows.slice(1, 61) // حتى 60 صفاً حتى يبقى الرسم مقروءاً
  const numeric = head.map((_, c) => { const v = body.map(r => r[c]).filter(x => (x ?? '').trim() !== ''); return v.length > 0 && v.every(x => !isNaN(toNum(x))) })

  const load = (t: string) => {
    setText(t)
    const r = parseCSV(t), h = r[0] ?? [], b = r.slice(1, 61)
    const num = h.map((_, c) => { const v = b.map(x => x[c]).filter(x => (x ?? '').trim() !== ''); return v.length > 0 && v.every(x => !isNaN(toNum(x))) })
    const x = Math.max(0, num.findIndex(n => !n))
    setXi(x)
    setYs(h.map((_, i) => i).filter(i => num[i] && i !== x).slice(0, 3))
  }

  const labels = body.map(r => r[xi] ?? '')
  const series: Ser[] = ys.filter(c => numeric[c]).map(c => ({ name: head[c] ?? '', vals: body.map(r => toNum(r[c])) }))
  const xs = numeric[xi] ? body.map(r => toNum(r[xi])) : null
  const stat = (v: number[]) => { const f = v.filter(isFinite); const s = f.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); return { n: f.length, min: Math.min(...f), max: Math.max(...f), sum: s, avg: s / (f.length || 1) } }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <label className={`${btn} cursor-pointer`}><FileUp size={14} className="ml-1 inline" />استيراد CSV<input type="file" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt" hidden onChange={async e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) load(await f.text()); e.target.value = '' }} /></label>
        <select className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }} defaultValue="" onChange={async e => { const f = items.find(i => i.id === e.target.value)?.file; if (f) load(await f.text()) }}>
          <option value="">من ملفات المكتبة…</option>
          {items.filter(i => i.file && /\.(csv|tsv|txt)$/i.test(i.name)).map(i => <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.name}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>
      <textarea value={text} onChange={e => load(e.target.value)} rows={4} dir="ltr" className={`${field} w-full font-mono text-xs`} />

      {head.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            {(['bar', 'line', 'scatter', 'pie'] as ChartType[]).map(t => (
              <button key={t} className={btn} onClick={() => setType(t)} style={type === t ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>{{ bar: 'أعمدة', line: 'خطي', scatter: 'نقطي', pie: 'دائري' }[t]}</button>
            ))}
            <label>المحور X <select value={xi} onChange={e => setXi(+e.target.value)} className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }}>{head.map((h, i) => <option key={i} value={i}>{h}</option>)}</select></label>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 text-sm">
            {head.map((h, i) => numeric[i] && (
              <label key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1"><input type="checkbox" checked={ys.includes(i)} onChange={e => setYs(a => (e.target.checked ? [...a, i] : a.filter(x => x !== i)))} />{h}</label>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className={`${panel} p-3`}><Chart type={type} labels={labels} series={series} xs={xs} /></div>
          <div className={`${panel} overflow-x-auto`}>
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead><tr className="opacity-60"><th className="p-2 text-right">العمود</th><th>العدد</th><th>الأدنى</th><th>الأعلى</th><th>المتوسط</th><th>المجموع</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{series.map(s => { const st = stat(s.vals); return <tr key={s.name} className="border-t border-white/10 text-center"><td className="p-2 text-right">{s.name}</td><td>{st.n}</td><td>{+st.min.toFixed(3)}</td><td>{+st.max.toFixed(3)}</td><td>{+st.avg.toFixed(3)}</td><td>{+st.sum.toFixed(3)}</td></tr> })}</tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
