<file path="src/components/DocumentTools.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Copy, Download, FileUp, Save } from 'lucide-react'
import { useLibrary, useTree } from '../shared'
import { ACCENT, askAI, btn, copy, download, field, flattenTree, hasAI, panel } from './toolkit'

const STOP = new Set('the and for that with this from have are was were not but you your من في على إلى عن أن هذا هذه التي الذي ذلك كان أو ثم قد لم لا ما هو هي كما أي بعد قبل عند حتى'.split(' '))

// تلخيص استخلاصي محلي: نختار الجمل الأعلى وزناً حسب تكرار كلماتها المهمة
function summarize(text: string, n: number): string[] {
  const sents = text.split(/(?<=[.!?؟])\s+|\n+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s.split(/\s+/).length >= 4)
  const freq = new Map<string, number>()
  const words = (s: string) => (s.toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]{3,}/gu) ?? []).filter(w => !STOP.has(w))
  sents.forEach(s => words(s).forEach(w => freq.set(w, (freq.get(w) ?? 0) + 1)))
  const scored = sents.map((s, i) => ({ s, i, v: words(s).reduce((a, w) => a + (freq.get(w) ?? 0), 0) / Math.sqrt(s.length) }))
  return scored.sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v).slice(0, n).sort((a, b) => a.i - b.i).map(x => x.s)
}

export default function DocumentTools() {
  const { items, add } = useLibrary()
  const { tree, path } = useTree()
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState('')
  const [lang, setLang] = useState('ara+eng')
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [prog, setProg] = useState(0)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('')
  const [bullets, setBullets] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [n, setN] = useState(5)
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(path[path.length - 1] ?? '')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!file) return setPreview('')
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(file)
    setPreview(u)
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(u)
  }, [file])

  const ocr = async () => {
    if (!file) return
    setBusy(true); setProg(0); setMsg('جارٍ تجهيز محرك القراءة (أول مرة يحمّل بيانات اللغة من الإنترنت)…')
    try {
      const { createWorker } = await import('tesseract.js')
      const w = await createWorker(lang, 1, { logger: m => { if (m.status === 'recognizing text') { setProg(m.progress); setMsg('جارٍ قراءة النص…') } } })
      const { data } = await w.recognize(file)
      await w.terminate()
      setText(data.text.trim())
      setMsg(data.text.trim() ? 'تم استخراج النص. يمكنك تعديله ثم تلخيصه.' : 'لم يُعثر على نص. جرّب صورة أوضح أو لغة مختلفة.')
    } catch (e) { setMsg('تعذّر الاستخراج: ' + (e as Error).message) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }

  const sum = async (ai: boolean) => {
    setMsg('')
    if (!ai) return setBullets(summarize(text, n))
    setBusy(true)
    try {
      const r = await askAI('summary', `لخّص النص التالي في نقاط موجزة باللغة العربية، كل نقطة في سطر يبدأ بـ "- ":\n${text.slice(0, 12000)}`)
      setBullets(r.split('\n').map(l => l.replace(/^[-•*\s]+/, '').trim()).filter(Boolean))
    } catch (e) { setMsg((e as Error).message) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }

  const saveTxt = () => {
    if (!target) return setMsg('اختر فرعاً لحفظ الملف فيه')
    const body = bullets.length ? `${text}\n\n--- ملخص ---\n${bullets.map(b => '• ' + b).join('\n')}` : text
    const f = new File([body], `ocr-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16)}.txt`, { type: 'text/plain' })
    add({ nodeId: target, name: f.name, kind: 'doc', url: URL.createObjectURL(f), size: f.size, file: f })
    setMsg('تم الحفظ كملف نصي في الفرع')
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <label className={`${btn} cursor-pointer`}><FileUp size={14} className="ml-1 inline" />رفع صورة<input type="file" accept="image/*" hidden onChange={e => { setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null); e.target.value = '' }} /></label>
        <select className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }} defaultValue="" onChange={e => setFile(items.find(i => i.id === e.target.value)?.file ?? null)}>
          <option value="">من صور المكتبة…</option>
          {items.filter(i => i.file && (i.kind === 'image' || i.kind === 'drawing')).map(i => <option key={i.id} value={i.id}>{i.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        <select className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }} value={lang} onChange={e => setLang(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="ara+eng">عربي + إنجليزي</option><option value="eng">إنجليزي</option><option value="ara">عربي</option>
        </select>
        <button className={btn} disabled={!file || busy} onClick={ocr} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }}>استخراج النص</button>
      </div>
      {preview && <img src={preview} alt="الصورة المختارة" className="max-h-48 rounded-lg border border-white/10" />}
      {busy && <div className="h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/10"><motion.div className="h-full" style={{ background: ACCENT }} animate={{ width: `${Math.max(5, prog * 100)}%` }} /></div>}
      {msg && <p className="text-sm opacity-80">{msg}</p>}

      <textarea value={text} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)} rows={8} placeholder="النص المستخرج (قابل للتحديد والتعديل). يمكنك أيضاً لصق أي نص هنا." className={`${field} w-full`} />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => copy(text)}><Copy size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />نسخ</button>
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => download('text.txt', text)}><Download size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />تنزيل txt</button>
        <label className="mr-auto">النقاط <input type="number" min={2} max={12} value={n} onChange={e => setN(+e.target.value || 5)} className={`${field} w-14`} /></label>
        <button className={btn} disabled={text.trim().length < 40} onClick={() => sum(false)} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }}>تلخيص</button>
        {hasAI() && <button className={btn} disabled={busy || text.trim().length < 40} onClick={() => sum(true)}>تلخيص بالذكاء الاصطناعي</button>}
      </div>

      {bullets.length > 0 && (
        <div className={`${panel} space-y-2 p-3 text-sm`}>
          {bullets.map((b, i) => <motion.p key={i} initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }}>• {b}</motion.p>)}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
            <button className={btn} onClick={() => copy(bullets.map(b => '• ' + b).join('\n'))}><Copy size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />نسخ الملخص</button>
            <button className={btn} onClick={() => download('summary.md', bullets.map(b => '- ' + b).join('\n'), 'text/markdown')}><Download size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />تنزيل md</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-white/10 pt-3 text-sm">
        <select className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }} value={target} onChange={e => setTarget(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="">اختر فرعاً للحفظ…</option>
          {flattenTree(tree).map(f => <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>{f.label}</option>)}
        </select>
        <button className={btn} disabled={!text.trim()} onClick={saveTxt}><Save size={13} className="ml-1 inline" />حفظ كملف نصي في الفرع</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/FloatingWindow.tsx">
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { CSSProperties, PointerEvent as RPointerEvent, ReactNode } from 'react'
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { ChevronUp, Maximize2, Minimize2, Minus, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { sfx } from '../shared'
import { useSettings } from '../lib/settings'
import { ACCENT } from './toolkit'

/* ============ الأنواع ============ */
export interface WinRect {
  x: number // المسافة من يسار الشاشة (بكسل)
  y: number // المسافة من أعلى الشاشة
  w: number // العرض
  h: number // الارتفاع
}

interface Props {
  title: string
  icon?: ReactNode
  initial: WinRect                          // الموضع والحجم عند الفتح (يُستخدم مرة واحدة)
  minimized: boolean                        // الحالة يملكها الأب لتُستعاد عند النقر على أيقونة الأداة
  onMinimizeChange: (m: boolean) => void
  onClose: () => void
  onFocus: () => void                       // يرفع النافذة فوق غيرها
  zIndex: number
  children: ReactNode
}

const MIN_W = 280
const MIN_H = 180

// يبقي النافذة داخل الشاشة: شريط العنوان يظل ظاهراً وقابلاً للإمساك دائماً
function clampRect(r: WinRect): WinRect {
  const vw = window.innerWidth
  const vh = window.innerHeight
  const w = Math.min(Math.max(r.w, MIN_W), Math.max(MIN_W, vw - 16))
  const h = Math.min(Math.max(r.h, MIN_H), Math.max(MIN_H, vh - 72))
  const x = Math.min(Math.max(r.x, 100 - w), vw - 100)
  const y = Math.min(Math.max(r.y, 0), vh - 44)
  return { x, y, w, h }
}

interface Gesture {
  px: number // موضع المؤشر عند البداية
  py: number
  r: WinRect // حالة النافذة عند البداية
}

export default function FloatingWindow({ title, icon, initial, minimized, onMinimizeChange, onClose, onFocus, zIndex, children }: Props) {
  const { windowStyle } = useSettings()
  const solid = windowStyle === 'solid'
  const [rect, setRect] = useState<WinRect>(() => clampRect(initial))
  const [maximized, setMaximized] = useState<boolean>(() => window.innerWidth < 640)
  const dragRef = useRef<Gesture | null>(null)
  const resizeRef = useRef<Gesture | null>(null)

  // عند تغيّر حجم المتصفح نعيد النافذة إلى داخل الشاشة
  useEffect(() => {
    const onResize = (): void => setRect(r => clampRect(r))
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
  }, [])

  /* ---------- السحب من شريط العنوان ---------- */
  const startDrag = (e: RPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void => {
    if (maximized) return
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) return // لا نسحب عند النقر على الأزرار
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
    dragRef.current = { px: e.clientX, py: e.clientY, r: rect }
  }
  const moveDrag = (e: RPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void => {
    const d = dragRef.current
    if (!d) return
    setRect(clampRect({ ...d.r, x: d.r.x + e.clientX - d.px, y: d.r.y + e.clientY - d.py }))
  }
  const endDrag = (): void => { dragRef.current = null }

  /* ---------- التحجيم من مقبض الزاوية ---------- */
  const startResize = (e: RPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void => {
    e.stopPropagation()
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
    resizeRef.current = { px: e.clientX, py: e.clientY, r: rect }
  }
  const moveResize = (e: RPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>): void => {
    const d = resizeRef.current
    if (!d) return
    setRect(clampRect({ ...d.r, w: d.r.w + e.clientX - d.px, h: d.r.h + e.clientY - d.py }))
  }
  const endResize = (): void => { resizeRef.current = null }

  const toggleMax = (): void => { sfx.click(); setMaximized(m => !m) }

  const frame: CSSProperties = maximized
    ? { left: 8, top: 64, width: 'calc(100vw - 16px)', height: minimized ? 'auto' : 'calc(100dvh - 72px)' }
    : { left: rect.x, top: rect.y, width: rect.w, height: minimized ? 'auto' : rect.h }

  // الوضع العاتم: خلفية داكنة معتمة تحجب أي تشويش، مع إبقاء الحدود والظل كما هما
  const solidStyle: CSSProperties = solid
    ? { background: '#0d1117', backdropFilter: 'none', WebkitBackdropFilter: 'none' }
    : {}

  const ctl = 'flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md transition hover:bg-white/15 active:scale-90'

  // نرسم في document.body حتى لا تتأثر النافذة بأي عنصر أب (تحويلات أو تمرير)
  return createPortal(
    <motion.div
      role="dialog"
      aria-label={title}
      dir="rtl"
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
      onPointerDown={onFocus}
      className="glass-strong fixed flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl"
      style={{ ...frame, ...solidStyle, zIndex }}
    >
      {/* شريط العنوان: مقبض السحب */}
      <div
        onPointerDown={startDrag}
        onPointerMove={moveDrag}
        onPointerUp={endDrag}
        onPointerCancel={endDrag}
        onDoubleClick={toggleMax}
        className={`flex shrink-0 touch-none select-none items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 ${
          maximized ? '' : 'cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing'
        }`}
      >
        <h2 className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: ACCENT }}>
          {icon}
          <span className="truncate">{title}</span>
        </h2>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
          <button
            className={ctl}
            aria-label={minimized ? 'استعادة' : 'تصغير'}
            title={minimized ? 'استعادة' : 'تصغير'}
            onClick={() => { sfx.click(); onMinimizeChange(!minimized) }}
          >
            {minimized ? <ChevronUp size={15} /> : <Minus size={15} />}
          </button>
          <button
            className={ctl}
            aria-label={maximized ? 'استعادة الحجم' : 'تكبير'}
            title={maximized ? 'استعادة الحجم' : 'تكبير'}
            onClick={toggleMax}
          >
            {maximized ? <Minimize2 size={14} /> : <Maximize2 size={14} />}
          </button>
          <button
            className={`${ctl} hover:!bg-red-500/40`}
            aria-label="إغلاق"
            title="إغلاق"
            onClick={() => { sfx.close(); onClose() }}
          >
            <X size={15} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* المحتوى: يبقى مُركَّباً أثناء التصغير حتى لا تضيع حالة الأداة */}
      <div className={minimized ? 'hidden' : 'min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-auto p-3'}>{children}</div>

      {/* مقبض التحجيم (الزاوية السفلية اليمنى) */}
      {!maximized && !minimized && (
        <div
          aria-label="تغيير الحجم"
          onPointerDown={startResize}
          onPointerMove={moveResize}
          onPointerUp={endResize}
          onPointerCancel={endResize}
          className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 z-10 flex h-5 w-5 cursor-nwse-resize touch-none items-end justify-end p-0.5"
        >
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden>
            <path d="M11 1 1 11M11 6 6 11" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.45)" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </svg>
        </div>
      )}
    </motion.div>,
    document.body,
  )
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/Library.tsx">
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Download, Eye, FileText, Music, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { sfx, useLibrary } from '../shared'

type Filter = 'all' | 'image' | 'audio' | 'doc'
const FILTERS: { id: Filter; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'all', label: 'الكل' }, { id: 'image', label: 'صور' }, { id: 'audio', label: 'صوت' }, { id: 'doc', label: 'مستندات' },
]
const fmtSize = (n: number) => (n > 1048576 ? `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.max(1, Math.round(n / 1024))} KB`)

interface Props { nodeId: string; color: string }

// عرض ملفات فرع واحد فقط: تصنيف بالفلاتر + معاينة + عرض + تنزيل + حذف
export default function Library({ nodeId, color }: Props) {
  const { items, remove } = useLibrary()
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('all')
  const mine = items.filter(i => i.nodeId === nodeId) // عزل كامل بين الفروع
  const shown = mine.filter(i =>
    filter === 'all' ? true : filter === 'image' ? i.kind === 'image' || i.kind === 'drawing' : i.kind === filter,
  )

  if (!mine.length)
    return <p className="py-2 text-sm opacity-60">لا توجد ملفات في هذا الفرع بعد. ارفع ملفاً أو احفظ رسمة.</p>

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
        {FILTERS.map(f => (
          <button
            key={f.id}
            onClick={() => { setFilter(f.id); sfx.click() }}
            aria-pressed={filter === f.id}
            className="rounded-full px-3 py-0.5 text-xs"
            style={filter === f.id ? { background: color, color: '#111' } : { background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.1)' }}
          >
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {!shown.length && <p className="text-sm opacity-60">لا توجد ملفات من هذا النوع.</p>}
      <ul className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {shown.map(i => (
          <li key={i.id} className="group relative rounded-lg bg-white/5 p-2 text-xs">
            {i.kind === 'image' || i.kind === 'drawing' ? (
              <img src={i.url} alt={i.name} className="h-24 w-full rounded object-cover" />
            ) : i.kind === 'audio' ? (
              <div className="flex h-24 flex-col justify-center gap-1">
                <Music size={18} style={{ color }} />
                <audio controls src={i.url} className="w-full" />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex h-24 items-center justify-center"><FileText size={28} style={{ color }} /></div>
            )}
            <p className="mt-1 truncate" title={i.name}>{i.name}</p>
            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between opacity-80">
              <span>{fmtSize(i.size)}</span>
              <span className="flex gap-2">
                <a href={i.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`عرض ${i.name}`} title="عرض" onClick={() => sfx.click()}><Eye size={14} /></a>
                <a href={i.url} download={i.name} aria-label={`تنزيل ${i.name}`} title="تنزيل" onClick={() => sfx.click()}><Download size={14} /></a>
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              aria-label={`حذف ${i.name}`}
              onClick={() => { remove(i.id); sfx.click() }}
              className="absolute left-1 top-1 rounded bg-black/60 p-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100"
            >
              <Trash2 size={12} />
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

<file path="src/components/QuizGenerator.tsx">
import { useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { askAI, ACCENT, btn, field, hasAI, flattenTree, panel, subtreeIds } from './toolkit'
import { useLibrary, useTree } from '../shared'

interface Card { q: string; a: string; options?: string[] }
const STOP = new Set('this that with from have which their there where these those about would could should because between through after before other into than then them they were what when will your also been being more most some such only over very'.split(' '))
const shuffle = <T,>(a: T[]) => [...a].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5)

// مولّد محلي: يخفي أهم كلمة في كل جملة ويجعلها سؤال «أكمل الفراغ» مع مشتتات من النص نفسه
function makeCards(text: string, max: number): Card[] {
  const sents = text.split(/(?<=[.!?؟])\s+|\n+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => { const n = s.split(/\s+/).length; return n >= 6 && n <= 40 })
  const kw = (s: string) => (s.match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]{4,}/gu) ?? []).filter(w => !STOP.has(w.toLowerCase())).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0]
  const pool = [...new Set(sents.map(kw).filter((w): w is string => !!w))]
  return shuffle(sents).slice(0, max).flatMap(s => {
    const a = kw(s)
    if (!a) return []
    const q = s.replace(new RegExp(a.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')), '_____')
    const d = shuffle(pool.filter(p => p.toLowerCase() !== a.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 3)
    return [{ q, a, options: d.length === 3 ? shuffle([a, ...d]) : undefined }]
  })
}

export default function QuizGenerator() {
  const { items } = useLibrary()
  const { tree } = useTree()
  const [branch, setBranch] = useState('')
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [count, setCount] = useState(8)
  const [useAi, setUseAi] = useState(false)
  const [cards, setCards] = useState<Card[]>([])
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'cards' | 'quiz'>('cards')
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0)
  const [flip, setFlip] = useState(false)
  const [pick, setPick] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0)
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('')
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const loadFrom = async () => {
    const ids = branch ? subtreeIds(tree, branch) : null
    const files = items.filter(i => i.file && /\.(txt|md|csv|json)$/i.test(i.name) && (!ids || ids.includes(i.nodeId)))
    if (!files.length) return setMsg('لا توجد ملفات نصية (.txt .md .csv .json) في هذا النطاق. يمكنك لصق النص يدوياً، أو استخرجه من صورة عبر أداة المستندات.')
    setText((await Promise.all(files.map(i => i.file!.text()))).join('\n\n'))
    setMsg(`تم جلب ${files.length} ملف`)
  }

  const generate = async () => {
    setMsg(''); setBusy(true)
    try {
      let out: Card[] = []
      if (useAi && hasAI()) {
        const r = await askAI('quiz', `أنشئ ${count} أسئلة دراسية من النص التالي. أعد JSON فقط بالشكل [{"q":"السؤال","a":"الإجابة","options":["4 خيارات تتضمن الإجابة"]}] دون أي نص إضافي:\n${text.slice(0, 12000)}`)
        out = JSON.parse(r.slice(r.indexOf('['), r.lastIndexOf(']') + 1))
      } else out = makeCards(text, count)
      if (!out.length) setMsg('لم أتمكن من توليد أسئلة. تأكد أن النص يحتوي جملاً كاملة (6 كلمات فأكثر).')
      setCards(out); setIdx(0); setFlip(false); setPick(null); setScore(0)
    } catch (e) { setMsg('تعذّر التوليد: ' + (e as Error).message) } finally { setBusy(false) }
  }

  const quiz = cards.filter(c => c.options)
  const list = mode === 'quiz' ? quiz : cards
  const cur = list[idx]
  const go = (d: number) => { setIdx(i => Math.min(list.length - 1, Math.max(0, i + d))); setFlip(false); setPick(null) }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <select value={branch} onChange={e => setBranch(e.target.value)} className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }}>
          <option value="">كل الفروع</option>
          {flattenTree(tree).map(n => <option key={n.id} value={n.id}>{n.label}</option>)}
        </select>
        <button className={btn} onClick={loadFrom}>جلب نصوص الملفات</button>
      </div>
      <textarea value={text} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)} rows={5} placeholder="الصق ملاحظاتك هنا، أو اضغط «جلب نصوص الملفات»" className={`${field} w-full`} />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm">
        <label>عدد الأسئلة <input type="number" min={2} max={30} value={count} onChange={e => setCount(+e.target.value || 8)} className={`${field} w-16`} /></label>
        {hasAI() && <label className="flex items-center gap-1"><input type="checkbox" checked={useAi} onChange={e => setUseAi(e.target.checked)} />بالذكاء الاصطناعي</label>}
        <button className={btn} disabled={busy || text.trim().length < 40} onClick={generate} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }}>{busy ? 'جارٍ التوليد…' : 'توليد'}</button>
      </div>
      {msg && <p className="text-sm opacity-80">{msg}</p>}

      {cards.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button className={btn} onClick={() => { setMode('cards'); setIdx(0); setFlip(false) }} style={mode === 'cards' ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>بطاقات</button>
            <button className={btn} onClick={() => { setMode('quiz'); setIdx(0); setPick(null); setScore(0) }} style={mode === 'quiz' ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>اختبار</button>
            <span className="mr-auto self-center text-sm opacity-70">{list.length ? `${idx + 1} / ${list.length}` : ''}{mode === 'quiz' && ` — النتيجة ${score}`}</span>
          </div>
          {!cur && <p className="text-sm opacity-70">لا توجد أسئلة بخيارات (النص قصير). استخدم وضع البطاقات.</p>}
          {cur && mode === 'cards' && (
            <motion.button
              key={idx} onClick={() => setFlip(f => !f)} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, rotateX: flip ? 180 : 0 }}
              className={`${panel} flex min-h-40 w-full items-center justify-center p-5 text-center text-lg`}
            >
              <span style={{ transform: flip ? 'rotateX(180deg)' : 'none', color: flip ? ACCENT : undefined, display: 'block' }}>{flip ? cur.a : cur.q}</span>
            </motion.button>
          )}
          {cur && mode === 'quiz' && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className={`${panel} p-4 text-lg`}>{cur.q}</p>
              <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {cur.options!.map(o => {
                  const shown = pick !== null
                  const bg = !shown ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.1)' : o === cur.a ? '#34d39955' : o === pick ? '#f8717155' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)'
                  return (
                    <button key={o} disabled={shown} className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm transition" style={{ background: bg }}
                      onClick={() => { setPick(o); if (o === cur.a) setScore(s => s + 1) }}>{o}</button>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button className={btn} disabled={idx === 0} onClick={() => go(-1)}>السابق</button>
            <button className={btn} disabled={idx >= list.length - 1} onClick={() => go(1)}>التالي</button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/SettingsModal.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { ArchiveRestore, Bot, Check, Moon, Palette, RotateCcw, Sparkles, Square, Trash2, Wrench, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { sfx, useLibrary, useTree } from '../shared'
import {
  ACCENT_PRESETS, AI_PERSONALITIES, TOOL_CATALOG, TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS,
  readableOn, resetSettings, toggleToolVisibility, updateSettings, useSettings,
} from '../lib/settings'
import type { ThemeId } from '../lib/settings'
import { collectNodeIds, daysLeft, emptyTrash, removeFromTrash, useTrash } from '../lib/trash'
import type { TrashEntry } from '../lib/trash'

type TabId = 'look' | 'tools' | 'trash' | 'ai'

const TABS: { id: TabId; label: string; Icon: typeof Palette }[] = [
  { id: 'look', label: 'المظهر والثيمات', Icon: Palette },
  { id: 'tools', label: 'تخصيص الأدوات', Icon: Wrench },
  { id: 'trash', label: `سلة المهملات (${TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS} يوم)`, Icon: Trash2 },
  { id: 'ai', label: 'الذكاء الاصطناعي', Icon: Bot },
]

const THEMES: { id: ThemeId; label: string; hint: string; Icon: typeof Sparkles }[] = [
  { id: 'space-live', label: 'فضاء حيّ', hint: 'نجوم وكواكب متحركة', Icon: Sparkles },
  { id: 'space-static', label: 'فضاء ثابت', hint: 'سديم خفيف، أخف على الجوال', Icon: Moon },
  { id: 'solid', label: 'داكن سادة', hint: 'بلا خلفية متحركة، أعلى تباين', Icon: Square },
]

const HI = 'var(--accent)' // لون التوهّج العام، يتبع الإعدادات والفرع النشط

const fmtSize = (n: number): string => (n > 1048576 ? `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.max(1, Math.round(n / 1024))} KB`)

/* ============ مفتاح تبديل (Switch) ============ */
interface SwitchProps {
  on: boolean
  label: string
  onChange: (v: boolean) => void
}

function Switch({ on, label, onChange }: SwitchProps) {
  return (
    <button
      role="switch"
      aria-checked={on}
      aria-label={label}
      onClick={() => onChange(!on)}
      className="relative h-6 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors"
      style={{ background: on ? HI : 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)' }}
    >
      <span
        className="absolute top-0.5 h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all"
        style={{ insetInlineStart: on ? '1.375rem' : '0.125rem' }}
      />
    </button>
  )
}

/* ============ تبويب سلة المهملات ============ */
function TrashTab() {
  const { entries, ready, error } = useTrash()
  const { restoreNode } = useTree()
  const { add } = useLibrary()
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('')
  const chip = 'rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50'

  // الاستعادة: الفرع إلى موضعه الأصلي، وملفاته إلى المكتبة
  const restore = async (e: TrashEntry): Promise<void> => {
    if (busy) return
    setBusy(e.id)
    setMsg('')
    try {
      const res = restoreNode(e.node, e.parentId, e.index)
      if (res === 'conflict') {
        setMsg('تعذّرت الاستعادة: يوجد في الشجرة فرع بالمعرّف نفسه.')
        return
      }
      e.files.forEach(f =>
        add({ nodeId: f.nodeId, name: f.name, kind: f.kind, size: f.size, file: f.file, url: URL.createObjectURL(f.file) }),
      )
      await removeFromTrash(e.id)
      sfx.success()
      setMsg(
        res === 'root'
          ? `استُعيد «${e.title}» كقسم رئيسي لأن مكانه الأصلي لم يعد موجوداً.`
          : `استُعيد «${e.title}» إلى مكانه الأصلي.`,
      )
    } finally {
      setBusy(null)
    }
  }

  const purge = async (e: TrashEntry): Promise<void> => {
    if (busy || !window.confirm(`حذف «${e.title}» نهائياً؟ لا يمكن التراجع.`)) return
    setBusy(e.id)
    await removeFromTrash(e.id)
    sfx.close()
    setMsg('')
    setBusy(null)
  }

  const purgeAll = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (busy || !window.confirm('إفراغ سلة المهملات نهائياً؟ لا يمكن التراجع.')) return
    setBusy('all')
    await emptyTrash()
    sfx.close()
    setMsg('')
    setBusy(null)
  }

  if (!ready) return <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm opacity-60">جارٍ تحميل السلة…</p>
  if (error) return <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-red-300">{error}</p>

  return (
    <section className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm opacity-80">
          تُحفظ العناصر المحذوفة {TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS} يوماً ثم تُحذف نهائياً. عدد العناصر: {entries.length}
        </p>
        <button className={chip} disabled={!entries.length || busy !== null} onClick={() => { void purgeAll() }}>إفراغ السلة</button>
      </div>

      {msg && <p role="status" className="text-sm" style={{ color: HI }}>{msg}</p>}

      {!entries.length ? (
        <div className="space-y-2 py-8 text-center">
          <Trash2 size={36} className="mx-auto opacity-40" />
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">السلة فارغة</p>
          <p className="mx-auto max-w-sm text-xs opacity-60">الأقسام والفروع التي تحذفها تظهر هنا وتستطيع استعادتها.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {entries.map(e => {
            const left = daysLeft(e)
            const branches = collectNodeIds(e.node).length
            const size = e.files.reduce((a, f) => a + f.size, 0)
            return (
              <li key={e.id} className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
                    <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{e.title}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] opacity-60">
                      {branches} فرع · {e.files.length} ملف ({fmtSize(size)}) · حُذف {new Date(e.deletedAt).toLocaleDateString('ar')}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: left <= 7 ? '#fca5a5' : undefined }}>
                      يُحذف نهائياً بعد {left} يوم
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1">
                    <button
                      className={`${chip} flex items-center gap-1 text-xs`}
                      disabled={busy !== null}
                      onClick={() => { void restore(e) }}
                      style={{ background: HI, color: '#111' }}
                    >
                      <ArchiveRestore size={13} />استعادة
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className={`${chip} flex items-center gap-1 text-xs`}
                      disabled={busy !== null}
                      onClick={() => { void purge(e) }}
                      aria-label={`حذف ${e.title} نهائياً`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={13} />حذف نهائي
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            )
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  )
}

/* ============ نافذة الإعدادات ============ */
interface Props {
  open: boolean
  onClose: () => void
}

export default function SettingsModal({ open, onClose }: Props) {
  const s = useSettings()
  const trash = useTrash()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>('look')

  const onHi = s.accentMode === 'custom' ? readableOn(s.customAccent) : '#111'
  const sel = (active: boolean): CSSProperties => (active ? { background: HI, color: onHi } : {})

  // العودة لأول تبويب عند كل فتح
  useEffect(() => { if (open) setTab('look') }, [open])

  // الإغلاق بمفتاح Esc
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { sfx.close(); onClose() }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
  }, [open, onClose])

  const close = (): void => { sfx.close(); onClose() }
  const chip = 'rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95'
  const visibleCount = TOOL_CATALOG.filter(t => !s.hiddenTools.includes(t.id)).length

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="settings-modal"
          className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-3"
          style={{ zIndex: 2000 }} // فوق كل النوافذ العائمة
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
        >
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={close} />

          <motion.div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="الإعدادات"
            dir="rtl"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.98 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            className="glass-strong relative flex max-h-[88dvh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"
          >
            {/* الرأس */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-3">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold" style={{ color: HI }}>الإعدادات</h2>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  className={`${chip} flex items-center gap-1 text-xs`}
                  onClick={() => { if (window.confirm('إعادة كل الإعدادات إلى الافتراضي؟')) { sfx.click(); resetSettings() } }}
                >
                  <RotateCcw size={13} />إعادة الضبط
                </button>
                <button aria-label="إغلاق" onClick={close}><X size={18} /></button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* التبويبات */}
            <div role="tablist" aria-label="أقسام الإعدادات" className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-white/10 px-3 py-2">
              {TABS.map(({ id, label, Icon }) => (
                <button
                  key={id}
                  role="tab"
                  aria-selected={tab === id}
                  onClick={() => { sfx.click(); setTab(id) }}
                  className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95"
                  style={sel(tab === id)}
                >
                  <Icon size={14} />{label}
                  {id === 'trash' && trash.entries.length > 0 && (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-black/30 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums">{trash.entries.length}</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* المحتوى */}
            <div role="tabpanel" className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto p-4">
              {/* ===== المظهر والثيمات ===== */}
              {tab === 'look' && (
                <>
                  <section className="space-y-2">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">خلفية التطبيق</h3>
                    <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
                      {THEMES.map(({ id, label, hint, Icon }) => (
                        <button
                          key={id}
                          aria-pressed={s.theme === id}
                          onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ theme: id }) }}
                          className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-3 text-start transition hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95"
                          style={s.theme === id ? { borderColor: HI, boxShadow: `0 0 0 1px ${HI}` } : undefined}
                        >
                          <Icon size={18} style={{ color: s.theme === id ? HI : undefined }} />
                          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{label}</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] opacity-60">{hint}</p>
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  <section className="space-y-3">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">نوافذ الأدوات</h3>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button className={chip} style={sel(s.windowStyle === 'glass')} aria-pressed={s.windowStyle === 'glass'} onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ windowStyle: 'glass' }) }}>
                        زجاجية شفافة
                      </button>
                      <button className={chip} style={sel(s.windowStyle === 'solid')} aria-pressed={s.windowStyle === 'solid'} onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ windowStyle: 'solid' }) }}>
                        عاتمة (أوضح للنص)
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {s.windowStyle === 'glass' && (
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
                        <span className="shrink-0">الكثافة</span>
                        <input
                          type="range" min={30} max={98} step={1}
                          value={Math.round(s.glassOpacity * 100)}
                          onChange={e => updateSettings({ glassOpacity: Number(e.target.value) / 100 })}
                          className="flex-1"
                          aria-label="كثافة الزجاج"
                        />
                        <span className="w-10 text-end tabular-nums" dir="ltr">{Math.round(s.glassOpacity * 100)}%</span>
                      </label>
                    )}

                    {/* معاينة: نص خلفي يمرّ خلف نافذة بالإعدادات الحالية، فترى التباين مباشرة */}
                    <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl p-4" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(120deg,#8b5cf6,#3b82f6,#f9a8d4)' }}>
                      <p aria-hidden className="select-none text-3xl font-black leading-none text-white/90">ABC أبجد 123 XYZ هوز</p>
                      <div
                        className="-mt-4 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm"
                        style={{
                          background: s.windowStyle === 'solid' ? '#0d1117' : `rgba(12,14,26,${s.glassOpacity})`,
                          backdropFilter: s.windowStyle === 'solid' ? 'none' : 'blur(24px)',
                          WebkitBackdropFilter: s.windowStyle === 'solid' ? 'none' : 'blur(24px)',
                          border: '1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.25)',
                        }}
                      >
                        معاينة نافذة أداة: هل النص واضح؟
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  <section className="space-y-2">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">لون التوهّج</h3>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button className={chip} style={sel(s.accentMode === 'auto')} aria-pressed={s.accentMode === 'auto'} onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ accentMode: 'auto' }) }}>
                        تلقائي (يتبع الفرع)
                      </button>
                      <button className={chip} style={sel(s.accentMode === 'custom')} aria-pressed={s.accentMode === 'custom'} onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ accentMode: 'custom' }) }}>
                        مخصّص
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    {s.accentMode === 'custom' && (
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        {ACCENT_PRESETS.map(c => (
                          <button
                            key={c}
                            aria-label={`اللون ${c}`}
                            aria-pressed={s.customAccent.toLowerCase() === c}
                            onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ customAccent: c }) }}
                            className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition active:scale-90"
                            style={{ background: c, outline: s.customAccent.toLowerCase() === c ? '2px solid #fff' : 'none', outlineOffset: 2 }}
                          >
                            {s.customAccent.toLowerCase() === c && <Check size={14} color={readableOn(c)} />}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs opacity-80">
                          لون آخر
                          <input type="color" value={s.customAccent} onChange={e => updateSettings({ customAccent: e.target.value })} aria-label="اختيار لون مخصص" />
                        </label>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </section>
                </>
              )}

              {/* ===== تخصيص الأدوات ===== */}
              {tab === 'tools' && (
                <section className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <p className="text-sm opacity-80">الظاهرة في شريط الأدوات: {visibleCount} من {TOOL_CATALOG.length}</p>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button className={chip} onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ hiddenTools: [] }) }}>إظهار الكل</button>
                      <button className={chip} onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ hiddenTools: TOOL_CATALOG.map(t => t.id) }) }}>إخفاء الكل</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <ul className="space-y-1">
                    {TOOL_CATALOG.map(t => {
                      const on = !s.hiddenTools.includes(t.id)
                      return (
                        <li key={t.id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-white/5 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                          <span className={on ? '' : 'opacity-50'}>{t.label}</span>
                          <Switch on={on} label={`إظهار ${t.label}`} onChange={() => { sfx.click(); toggleToolVisibility(t.id) }} />
                        </li>
                      )
                    })}
                  </ul>
                </section>
              )}

              {/* ===== سلة المهملات ===== */}
              {tab === 'trash' && <TrashTab />}

              {/* ===== الذكاء الاصطناعي ===== */}
              {tab === 'ai' && (
                <section className="space-y-3">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">أسلوب الإجابة</h3>
                  <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="شخصية الذكاء الاصطناعي" className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    {AI_PERSONALITIES.map(p => (
                      <button
                        key={p.id}
                        role="radio"
                        aria-checked={s.aiPersonality === p.id}
                        onClick={() => { sfx.click(); updateSettings({ aiPersonality: p.id }) }}
                        className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-3 text-start transition hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95"
                        style={s.aiPersonality === p.id ? { borderColor: HI, boxShadow: `0 0 0 1px ${HI}` } : undefined}
                      >
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: s.aiPersonality === p.id ? HI : undefined }}>{p.label}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] opacity-60">{p.hint}</p>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </section>
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/Sketchpad.tsx">
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { PointerEvent as RPointerEvent } from 'react'
import { Eraser, Pencil, Save, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { sfx, useLibrary } from '../shared'

interface Props { nodeId: string; color: string }

// لوحة الرسم: تحفظ الرسمة كصورة PNG داخل الفرع نفسه
export default function Sketchpad({ nodeId, color }: Props) {
  const cv = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null)
  const drawing = useRef(false)
  const [pen, setPen] = useState(color)
  const [size, setSize] = useState(4)
  const [erase, setErase] = useState(false)
  const { add } = useLibrary()

  // تعبئة اللوحة بلون الخلفية الداكن (تُستخدم عند البدء وعند المسح)
  const fill = () => {
    const c = cv.current!.getContext('2d')!
    c.fillStyle = '#12151c'
    c.fillRect(0, 0, 900, 500)
  }
  useEffect(() => { fill() }, [])

  // تحويل موضع المؤشر إلى إحداثيات اللوحة الحقيقية (900×500)
  const pt = (e: RPointerEvent): [number, number] => {
    const r = cv.current!.getBoundingClientRect()
    return [((e.clientX - r.left) * 900) / r.width, ((e.clientY - r.top) * 500) / r.height]
  }
  const down = (e: RPointerEvent) => {
    drawing.current = true
    cv.current!.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
    const c = cv.current!.getContext('2d')!
    c.beginPath()
    c.moveTo(...pt(e))
  }
  const move = (e: RPointerEvent) => {
    if (!drawing.current) return
    const c = cv.current!.getContext('2d')!
    c.lineCap = 'round'
    c.lineJoin = 'round'
    c.strokeStyle = erase ? '#12151c' : pen
    c.lineWidth = erase ? size * 4 : size
    c.lineTo(...pt(e))
    c.stroke()
  }
  const save = () =>
    cv.current!.toBlob(b => {
      if (!b) return
      const name = `sketch-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16)}.png`
      add({ nodeId, name, kind: 'drawing', url: URL.createObjectURL(b), size: b.size, file: new File([b], name, { type: 'image/png' }) })
      sfx.success()
    })

  const btn = 'flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-2 py-1 text-sm bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20'
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2" dir="ltr">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <button className={btn} aria-pressed={!erase} onClick={() => { setErase(false); sfx.click() }}><Pencil size={14} />قلم</button>
        <button className={btn} aria-pressed={erase} onClick={() => { setErase(true); sfx.click() }}><Eraser size={14} />ممحاة</button>
        <input type="color" aria-label="لون القلم" value={pen} onChange={e => setPen(e.target.value)} />
        <input type="range" aria-label="حجم الفرشاة" min={1} max={20} value={size} onChange={e => setSize(+e.target.value)} />
        <button className={btn} onClick={() => { fill(); sfx.click() }}><Trash2 size={14} />مسح</button>
        <button className={btn + ' ml-auto'} style={{ background: color, color: '#111' }} onClick={save}><Save size={14} />حفظ في الفرع</button>
      </div>
      <canvas
        ref={cv}
        width={900}
        height={500}
        className="w-full touch-none rounded-lg border border-white/10"
        onPointerDown={down}
        onPointerMove={move}
        onPointerUp={() => { drawing.current = false }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/SpaceBackground.tsx">
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import * as THREE from 'three'

function Stars({ color }: { color: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.Points>(null!)
  const cur = useRef(new THREE.Color(color))
  const target = useRef(new THREE.Color(color))
  const pos = useMemo(
    () => Float32Array.from({ length: 2400 * 3 }, () => (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14),
    [],
  )

  useFrame(({ pointer, clock }, dt) => {
    target.current.set(color)
    cur.current.lerp(target.current, Math.min(1, dt * 3))
    ;(ref.current.material as THREE.PointsMaterial).color.copy(cur.current)
    ref.current.rotation.y += (pointer.x * 0.6 + clock.elapsedTime * 0.03 - ref.current.rotation.y) * 0.04
    ref.current.rotation.x += (-pointer.y * 0.4 - ref.current.rotation.x) * 0.04
  })

  return (
    <points ref={ref}>
      <bufferGeometry>
        <bufferAttribute attach="attributes-position" args={[pos, 3]} />
      </bufferGeometry>
      <pointsMaterial size={0.03} sizeAttenuation transparent opacity={0.85} depthWrite={false} />
    </points>
  )
}

export default function SpaceBackground({ color }: { color: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 -z-10">
      <Canvas dpr={[1, 1.5]} camera={{ position: [0, 0, 6], fov: 60 }}>
        <Stars color={color} />
      </Canvas>
    </div>
  )
}

<file path="src/components/TaskRoadmap.tsx">
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Check, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { useTree } from '../shared'
import { ACCENT, btn, colorOf, field, flattenTree, panel, usePersisted } from './toolkit'

interface Task { id: string; title: string; project: string; due: string; done: boolean }

const Bar = ({ pct, color }: { pct: number; color: string }) => (
  <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/10"><motion.div className="h-full rounded-full" style={{ background: color }} initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${pct}%` }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }} /></div>
)
const days = (d: string) => Math.ceil((new Date(d + 'T23:59:59').getTime() - Date.now()) / 864e5)
const dueLabel = (d: string) => { const n = days(d); return n < 0 ? `متأخرة ${-n} يوم` : n === 0 ? 'اليوم' : n === 1 ? 'غداً' : `بعد ${n} يوم` }

export default function TaskRoadmap() {
  const { tree } = useTree()
  const flat = useMemo(() => flattenTree(tree), [tree])
  const [tasks, setTasks] = usePersisted<Task[]>('atelier-tasks-v1', [])
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('')
  const [project, setProject] = useState('')
  const [due, setDue] = useState('')
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'active' | 'done'>('all')

  const proj = (id: string) => flat.find(f => f.id === id) // فرع محذوف يُعامل كمهمة عامة
  const add = () => { const t = title.trim(); if (!t) return; setTasks(a => [{ id: crypto.randomUUID(), title: t, project: project, due, done: false }, ...a]); setTitle('') }
  const pct = (l: Task[]) => (l.length ? Math.round((l.filter(t => t.done).length / l.length) * 100) : 0)

  const groups = [...new Set(tasks.map(t => (proj(t.project) ? t.project : '')))]
  const upcoming = tasks.filter(t => !t.done && t.due).sort((a, b) => a.due.localeCompare(b.due)).slice(0, 5)
  const shown = tasks.filter(t => (filter === 'all' ? true : filter === 'done' ? t.done : !t.done)).sort((a, b) => Number(a.done) - Number(b.done) || (a.due || '9').localeCompare(b.due || '9'))

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-3">
      <div className={`${panel} space-y-2 p-3`}>
        <div className="flex justify-between text-sm"><span>التقدم الكلي</span><b style={{ color: ACCENT }}>{pct(tasks)}%</b></div>
        <Bar pct={pct(tasks)} color={ACCENT} />
        {groups.length > 0 && (
          <div className="grid gap-2 pt-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {groups.map(g => {
              const list = tasks.filter(t => (proj(t.project) ? t.project : '') === g)
              const p = proj(g)
              return (
                <div key={g || 'general'} className="space-y-1 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex justify-between"><span>{p?.label.replace(/^[— ]+/, '') ?? 'عام'}</span><span>{list.filter(t => t.done).length}/{list.length}</span></div>
                  <Bar pct={pct(list)} color={p ? colorOf(p.ci) : '#9aa1b2'} />
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <input value={title} onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && add()} placeholder="مهمة جديدة…" className={`${field} min-w-40 flex-1`} />
        <select value={project} onChange={e => setProject(e.target.value)} className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }}>
          <option value="">عام</option>
          {flat.map(f => <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>{f.label}</option>)}
        </select>
        <input type="date" value={due} onChange={e => setDue(e.target.value)} className={field} style={{ colorScheme: 'dark' }} />
        <button className={btn} onClick={add} style={{ background: ACCENT, color: '#111' }}><Plus size={14} className="ml-1 inline" />إضافة</button>
      </div>

      {upcoming.length > 0 && (
        <div className={`${panel} p-3`}>
          <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold">خارطة الطريق: الأقرب موعداً</p>
          <ol className="space-y-1 border-r-2 pr-3 text-sm" style={{ borderColor: ACCENT + '88' }}>
            {upcoming.map(t => <li key={t.id} className="flex justify-between gap-2"><span>{t.title}</span><span className={days(t.due) < 0 ? 'text-red-300' : 'opacity-70'}>{dueLabel(t.due)}</span></li>)}
          </ol>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-2">
        {([['all', 'الكل'], ['active', 'غير المنجزة'], ['done', 'المنجزة']] as const).map(([k, l]) => (
          <button key={k} className={btn} onClick={() => setFilter(k)} style={filter === k ? { background: ACCENT, color: '#111' } : {}}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <ul className="space-y-2">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {shown.map(t => {
            const p = proj(t.project)
            return (
              <motion.li layout key={t.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} className={`${panel} flex items-center gap-3 p-3`}>
                <button aria-label="إنجاز" onClick={() => setTasks(a => a.map(x => (x.id === t.id ? { ...x, done: !x.done } : x)))} className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border transition active:scale-90" style={{ borderColor: ACCENT, background: t.done ? ACCENT : 'transparent' }}>
                  {t.done && <Check size={14} color="#111" />}
                </button>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className={`truncate text-sm ${t.done ? 'line-through opacity-50' : ''}`}>{t.title}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs opacity-60">{p ? p.label.replace(/^[— ]+/, '') : 'عام'}{t.due && <span className={!t.done && days(t.due) < 0 ? ' text-red-300' : ''}> · {dueLabel(t.due)}</span>}</p>
                </div>
                <button aria-label="حذف" onClick={() => setTasks(a => a.filter(x => x.id !== t.id))} className="opacity-60 hover:opacity-100"><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
              </motion.li>
            )
          })}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </ul>
      {!shown.length && <p className="py-4 text-center text-sm opacity-60">لا توجد مهام هنا. أضف أول مهمة من الأعلى.</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

<file path="src/components/toolkit.ts">
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react'
import { PALETTE, findNode } from '../shared'
import type { TNode } from '../shared'

/* ============ الأنماط المشتركة (زجاج داكن + بنفسجي) ============ */
export const ACCENT = '#a78bfa'
export const panel = 'rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.04] backdrop-blur-md'
export const btn = 'rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95'
export const field = 'rounded-lg bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none transition focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#a78bfa]'

/* ============ الذكاء الاصطناعي (اختياري) ============ */
// رابط خادمك الوسيط الذي يحتفظ بمفتاح النموذج. يستقبل { task, prompt } ويعيد { answer }.
// لا تضع مفتاح النموذج داخل كود المتصفح أبداً.
export const AI_ENDPOINT: string = ''
export const hasAI = () => AI_ENDPOINT !== ''
export async function askAI(task: string, prompt: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!AI_ENDPOINT) throw new Error('ضع رابط الخادم في AI_ENDPOINT داخل src/components/toolkit.ts')
  const r = await fetch(AI_ENDPOINT, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ task, prompt }),
  })
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`فشل الاتصال بخدمة الذكاء الاصطناعي (${r.status})`)
  return String((await r.json()).answer ?? '')
}

/* ============ مساعدات الشجرة ============ */
export interface FlatNode { id: string; label: string; ci: number }
export function flattenTree(nodes: TNode[], depth = 0): FlatNode[] {
  return nodes.flatMap(n => [{ id: n.id, label: '— '.repeat(depth) + n.title, ci: n.ci }, ...flattenTree(n.children, depth + 1)])
}
export const colorOf = (ci: number) => PALETTE[ci % PALETTE.length]
// معرّف الفرع وكل فروعه التابعة
export function subtreeIds(tree: TNode[], id: string): string[] {
  const walk = (n: TNode): string[] => [n.id, ...n.children.flatMap(walk)]
  const n = findNode(tree, id)
  return n ? walk(n) : []
}

/* ============ تنزيل ونسخ ============ */
export function download(name: string, text: string, type = 'text/plain') {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: `${type};charset=utf-8` }))
  const a = document.createElement('a')
  a.href = url
  a.download = name
  a.click()
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000)
}
export const copy = (t: string) => navigator.clipboard?.writeText(t).catch(() => { /* تجاهل */ })

/* ============ حالة محفوظة في localStorage (كتابة مؤجلة 300ms) ============ */
export function usePersisted<T>(key: string, init: T): [T, Dispatch<SetStateAction<T>>] {
  const [v, setV] = useState<T>(() => {
    try { const r = localStorage.getItem(key); return r ? (JSON.parse(r) as T) : init } catch { return init }
  })
  const latest = useRef(v)
  latest.current = v
  const write = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(latest.current)) } catch { /* تجاهل */ } }
  useEffect(() => { const t = setTimeout(write, 300); return () => clearTimeout(t) }, [v]) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => write, []) // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- نكتب آخر قيمة عند إغلاق الأداة
  return [v, setV]
}
